timeline.change: 三星电机高容47μF MLCC 8月17.50美元/100只涨至10月21.60美元、约+23%（Financial Post引TrendForce，10-24）；DigiKey渠道部分三星电机料号交期61周（10月）；国巨主力料交期30~52周
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics high-capacitance 47uF MLCC rises from $17.50/100 units in August to $21.60 in October, about +23% (Financial Post citing TrendForce, Oct 24); some Samsung Electro-Mechanics part numbers on DigiKey at 61-week lead times (October); Yageo main parts at 30-52 weeks

timeline.change: 三星电机MLCC交期延长至52周（韩媒10-20）、Q4消费级X5R MLCC提价25%~30%；国巨拟10月底~11月启动新一轮涨价（高容+50%、中低容+10%~30%），三环10月起对代理商+10%~30%；集邦预计Q4消费级中高容+10%~20%。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead time extended to 52 weeks (Korean press 10-20), Q4 consumer X5R prices +25%-30%; Yageo planning a new round late-Oct~Nov (+50% high-cap, +10%-30% mid/low-cap), Walsin +10%-30% to distributors from Oct; TrendForce expects Q4 consumer mid/high-cap +10%-20%.

timeline.change: TrendForce：AI服务器高容MLCC缺货延续至2027上半年，村田/SEMCO/太阳诱电book-to-bill达1.30/1.31/1.25（疫情后最高）；2027Q1议价11月启动，日厂可能跟随涨价。
timeline.text_en: TrendForce (10-29): AI-server high-capacitance MLCC shortage extends into 2027H1; Murata/SEMCO/Taiyo Yuden book-to-bill at 1.30/1.31/1.25 (post-pandemic highs); 2027Q1 pricing talks begin in November, Japanese makers likely to follow suit.

timeline.change: SEMCO Q4对OEM/ODM提价：消费级X5R约+25~30%、AI服务器X6S约+10~20%（rapidonline）。
timeline.text_en: SEMCO Q4 price hikes to OEM/ODM: consumer X5R +25-30%, AI-server X6S +10-20% (rapidonline).

timeline.change: 村田停产时间表明确：GRM/GRJ/GRT等九大系列特定料号2028-03-31最后下单、2029-03-31停止出货。
timeline.text_en: Murata EOL schedule clarified: nine series incl. GRM/GRJ/GRT phased out, last order Mar 31 2028, final shipment Mar 31 2029.

timeline.change: 三星电机 AI 服务器高容料号涨幅已达 50%~80%、Q4 正与下游协商季度环比涨价 25%+；太阳诱电官宣消费级高容料号涨价 50%~150%；国巨完成第二轮渠道调价（通用 +20%、刚需 +40%+）；三星电机签下 1.0722 万亿韩元 AI 服务器 MLCC 长单（公司史上最大单笔）
timeline.text_en: SEMCO AI-server high-capacitance parts up 50%~80%, Q4 QoQ hike of 25%+ under negotiation; Taiyo Yuden announced 50%~150% hike on consumer high-capacitance parts; Yageo completed second-round channel price increase (general +20%, core demand +40%+); SEMCO signed KRW 1.0722T AI-server MLCC long-term order (largest single MLCC order in company history)

timeline.change: 国巨规划10月底-11月新一轮涨价（高容或+50%+）；村田10-31宣布2026-2030财年1万亿日元扩产（产能利用率95%、冈山新产线2028年末投产）；TrendForce称2027H1高阶缺口最严重、11月启动2027Q1议价
timeline.text_en: Yageo plans new price hikes late-Oct to November (high-capacitance up to +50%+); Murata announced JPY 1T capex for 2026-2030 (95% utilization, new Okayama line online end-2028); TrendForce: severest high-end shortage in 2027H1, 2027Q1 negotiations start in November

timeline.change: TrendForce 10-29：高电容MLCC短缺持续至2027H1，1Q27价格谈判11月启动，村田新增产能不早于2028；村田10-30宣布2026-2030年合计投资约1兆日元扩产MLCC、目标2030年营收翻倍，Q3订单7534亿日元（+54.7%历史新高）；三星电机签下8800亿韩元AI服务器MLCC供应合同、累计AI服务器合同超5万亿韩元
timeline.text_en: TrendForce Oct 29: high-capacitance MLCC shortage through 1H27, 1Q27 price talks start November, Murata new capacity not before 2028; Murata Oct 30: ~1T yen MLCC capex 2026-2030, revenue target 2x by 2030, Q3 orders 753.4B yen (+54.7% record); Samsung Electro-Mechanics signs 880B won AI-server MLCC supply deal, cumulative AI-server contracts >5T won

timeline.change: 国巨规划10月底—11月新一轮MLCC涨价：高容料号50%或更多、中低容10%-30%，覆盖2026年内至2027Q1（继7月涨50%后，据券商跟踪）；iM证券11-02：村田legacy产品已启动涨价、产能利用率95%、AI服务器高容MLCC市占率约70%、需求至少旺到2028、短缺延续至2029；三星电机Q4消费级X5R涨25%-30%、高端X6S涨10%-20%；高端料号交期5-10个月。
timeline.text_en: Yageo plans another MLCC price round in late Oct-Nov: high-capacitance parts +50% or more, mid/low-capacitance +10%-30%, covering rest of 2026 through 1Q27 (after July +50%, per brokerage tracking); iM Securities Nov 2: Murata legacy products already raised prices, utilization at 95%, ~70% share of AI-server high-capacitance MLCC, demand strong through at least 2028, shortages extending into 2029; Samsung Electro-Mechanics 4Q consumer X5R +25%-30%, high-end X6S +10%-20%; high-end part lead times now 5-10 months.

timeline.change: KEMET钽电容第二轮涨价11-01生效（T520/T521/T530系列+20%-30%，由分销扩展至直销客户）；三星电机MLCC交期延至52周（部分经销商挂牌61周，9月为39-49周）；松下聚合物钽电容交期拉长至84周，70%-80%的2027年产能已被锁定。
timeline.text_en: KEMET second-round tantalum capacitor price increases took effect Nov 1 (T520/T521/T530 series +20%-30%, extended from distributors to direct customers); Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC lead times stretched to 52 weeks (some distributors list 61 weeks, vs 39-49 in September); Panasonic polymer tantalum lead times stretched to 84 weeks, with 70%-80% of 2027 capacity already locked.

timeline.change: 国巨新一轮涨价进入落地窗口（10 月底至 11 月），高容料号 +50% 以上、中低容 +10-30%；三星电机签下 1.0722 万亿韩元 AI 服务器 MLCC 长单，为公司史上最大单笔 MLCC 订单
timeline.text_en: Yageo’s new hike enters its landing window (late Oct to Nov): high-capacity parts +50% or more, mid/low-capacity +10-30%; Samsung Electro-Mechanics signed a KRW 1.0722 trillion AI-server MLCC long-term contract, its largest single MLCC order ever

timeline.change: 窗口内无新涨价函；三星电机 MLCC 在 DigiKey 标准交期 10 月已拉长至 61 周（9 月 39–49 周），村田约 17 周、国巨约 28 周；KEMET 钽电容第二轮 +20–30% 已于 11-01 生效，松下聚合物钽电容随后 +15–30%
timeline.text_en: No new price-hike notice in the window; Samsung Electro-Mechanics MLCC standard lead times at DigiKey stretched to 61 weeks in October (39-49 weeks in September), Murata ~17 weeks, Yageo ~28 weeks; KEMET's second-round tantalum price hike of 20-30% took effect Nov 1, followed by Panasonic polymer tantalum +15-30%

timeline.change: 村田 10-30 宣布 2026–2030 财年投入约 1 万亿日元扩产 MLCC；TrendForce 11-02 称 AI 高容 MLCC 短缺将于 2027 上半年达峰，交期约 35 周（正常约 12 周）、三星电机 52 周；三星电机 10-30 签下约 8,793 亿韩元 AI 服务器 MLCC 供应合同
timeline.text_en: Murata announced on Oct 30 a roughly JPY 1 trillion MLCC capacity expansion for FY2026–2030; TrendForce said on Nov 2 that the AI high-capacitance MLCC shortage will peak in H1 2027, with lead times of about 35 weeks (vs about 12 normally) and 52 weeks at Samsung Electro-Mechanics; Samsung Electro-Mechanics signed an AI-server MLCC supply contract worth about KRW 879.3 billion on Oct 30

timeline.change: 本窗口无新函；国巨新一轮涨价仍处规划阶段、无原厂函件确认；松下聚合物钽电容跟进 +15%~30%、交期最长 84 周（见 KEMET 钽电容事件）
timeline.text_en: No new notice in this window; Yageo's next hike round still in planning with no factory letter confirmed; Panasonic polymer tantalum followed at +15%-30% with lead times up to 84 weeks (see KEMET tantalum event)

timeline.change: 三星电机 Q4 起对部分客户涨价（消费级 X5R +25-30%、AI 服务器 X6S +10-20%）、AI 服务器 MLCC 交期约 35 周；村田 MLCC 订单达销售额 1.47 倍；国巨新一轮涨价仍为券商研报口径、未见官方函
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics raising prices for some customers from Q4 (consumer X5R +25-30%, AI-server X6S +10-20%), AI-server MLCC lead times about 35 weeks; Murata MLCC book-to-bill at 1.47x sales; Yageo's next hike round still only a brokerage-research claim, no official notice seen

timeline.change: TrendForce 称高端 MLCC 短缺延至 2027 年上半年、最严重在 2027Q1-Q2，1Q27 议价 11 月启动；三星电机 4Q 涨价扩至直供 OEM/ODM 客户；部分三星电机 MLCC 在 DigiKey 标准交期已达 61 周（9 月为 39-49 周），村田 17 周、国巨 28 周。
timeline.text_en: TrendForce said the high-end MLCC shortage extends through 1H27, worst in 1Q-2Q27, with 1Q27 price talks starting in November; Samsung Electro-Mechanics extended its 4Q price hikes to direct OEM/ODM customers; some Samsung MLCCs reached a 61-week standard lead time at DigiKey (39-49 weeks in September), vs 17 weeks for Murata and 28 for Yageo.

timeline.change: 松下跟进聚合物钽电容 +15%–30%、二氧化锰型 +10%–20%，部分聚合物钽最长交期 84 周，2027 年产能已订出 70%–80%（KEMET 第二轮涨价 11-01 生效已报）；三星电机部分型号 DigiKey 标准交期 61 周，11 月内启动 2027 年一季度议价。
timeline.text_en: Panasonic followed with polymer tantalum capacitors +15%-30% and manganese-dioxide types +10%-20%; some polymer tantalum lead times reach 84 weeks, with 70%-80% of 2027 capacity already booked (KEMET's second-round hike took effect Nov 1); Samsung Electro-Mechanics standard lead times on some models via DigiKey reached 61 weeks, and Q1 2027 price talks start within November.

timeline.change: 三星电机 Q4 起将涨价延伸至直供 OEM/ODM 客户，消费级 X5R 约 +25–30%、AI 服务器 X6S +10–20%（TrendForce 估算、非公司确认）；国巨下一轮高容酝酿 +50% 以上、中低容 +10–30%（分销商口径、未确认）。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics extended its Q4 price hikes to direct OEM/ODM customers, consumer X5R up about 25-30% and AI-server X6S up 10-20% (TrendForce estimates, not company-confirmed); Yageo is reported to be preparing a next round of over +50% on high-capacitance and +10-30% on mid/low-capacitance (distributor accounts, unconfirmed).

timeline.change: 三星电机交期 52 周，AI 服务器高容产品涨幅 50%–80%（产业梳理口径）、正协商季度环比再涨 25% 以上；村田高端缺货延续至 2027 年上半年；2027 年 Q1 价格谈判本月启动。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics lead time 52 weeks; AI-server high-capacitance MLCC up 50%-80% (industry compilation), negotiating a further 25%+ quarterly rise; Murata high-end shortage extends into H1 2027; Q1 2027 price talks started this month.

timeline.change: 三星电机 11-18 被曝预收款超 1 万亿韩元、MLCC 产线满产且库存历史低位，TrendForce 口径交期 40 周，Q3 MLCC 均价较去年均价涨 21.4%；三环高容供需偏紧、2027 年 AI 服务器 MLCC 订单有望翻倍。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics was reported Nov 18 to hold over KRW 1 trillion in advance payments, with MLCC lines at full capacity and inventories at historic lows; TrendForce put lead times at 40 weeks and Q3 MLCC average prices up 21.4% vs last year's average; Sanhuan's high-capacitance supply is tight and its 2027 AI-server MLCC orders may double.

timeline.change: 三星电机截至 Q3 末长期供货合同预收款 7.77 亿美元（约 1 万亿韩元），较 6 月末 +43.9%；TrendForce 预估 Q4 消费级 X5R 对 OEM/ODM 均价或再涨 25%–30%（预估口径）。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics' long-term supply contract prepayments reached $777 million (about KRW 1 trillion) at end-Q3, up 43.9% from end-June; TrendForce estimates Q4 consumer X5R prices to OEM/ODM customers could rise another 25%-30% (estimate, not in effect).

timeline.change: TrendForce 将 MLCC 供需评估上调至“非常紧张”，交期 40 周（Meritz 称三星电机全线 52 周）；Q4 消费级 X5R 对 OEM/ODM 均价或再涨 25%–30%（预估）。
timeline.text_en: TrendForce raised its MLCC supply-demand assessment to "Very Tight", with lead times of 40 weeks (Meritz says Samsung Electro-Mechanics' full line is at 52 weeks); Q4 consumer-grade X5R prices to OEM/ODM customers may rise another 25-30% (estimate).

timeline.change: 三星电机 Q3 MLCC 均价同比 +21.4%；Q4 涨价扩大至 AI 用 X6S +10%–20%（TrendForce 估计），消费级 X5R +25%–30%。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Electro-Mechanics Q3 MLCC average price +21.4% YoY; Q4 hikes extend to AI-grade X6S +10%-20% (TrendForce estimate), consumer X5R +25%-30%.

timeline.text_en: LME 3-month copper closed Oct 20 at $14,391/t (+0.36%); SHFE main contract RMB 109,550/t (-0.27%); Goldman Sachs raised its end-2026 forecast to $14,700/t and its 2027 average to 15,400; copper-concentrate TC at -$237.8/dmt (Oct 9, a near-decade low); Antofagasta Centinela spot TC -310, Los Pelambres -330 $/t (Reuters, Oct 16)

timeline.change: Westmetall 10-20收14,357美元/吨（官方口径；昨日新华财经口径14,391已按官方值修正）；SHFE cu2611 10-21收109,390元/吨（+0.18%）；1#废铜93,200~93,400元/吨（-300）（Mysteel 10-21）；仍处历史高位区
timeline.text_en: Westmetall closed Oct 20 at $14,357/t (official basis; yesterday's Xinhua Finance figure of 14,391 corrected to the official value); SHFE cu2611 closed Oct 21 at RMB 109,390/t (+0.18%); #1 scrap copper RMB 93,200~93,400/t (-300) (Mysteel, Oct 21); still in historic-high territory

timeline.change: LME 3M铜10-19报14342美元/吨（-0.4%，路透）；洋山铜溢价10-22报158美元/吨、为2014年2月以来最高（中国进口需求紧张；此前大量铜为规避美国关税预期涌入美国）（路透，10-22）；嘉能可2025年铜产量85.16万吨（预估区间低端，同比-11%）
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper closed at $14,342/ton on Oct 19 (-0.4%, Reuters); Yangshan copper premium hit $158/ton on Oct 22, the highest since Feb 2014 (tight Chinese import demand; earlier copper flowed into the US on tariff expectations) (Reuters, Oct 22); Glencore's 2025 copper output at 850.6kt, the low end of guidance (-11% YoY)
LME 3M copper closed at $14,098/t on Oct 23 (-1.90%), down ~1.7% from the Oct 19 high of $14,342; SHFE copper cu2611 closed at ¥108,030/t (-0.74%)

timeline.change: Westmetall：LME 3M铜10-23收14270美元/吨，高于10-22的14096；LME库存273750吨（+800）连续回升
timeline.text_en: Westmetall: LME 3-month copper closed Oct 23 at $14,270/t, above $14,096 on Oct 22; LME stocks at 273,750 t (+800), rising for consecutive days

timeline.change: SMM 10-27晨会：LME铜隔夜收14,338美元/吨、+0.28%；10-27盘面铜约14,370美元/吨（SP Angel）
timeline.text_en: SMM Oct 27 morning briefing: LME copper closed overnight at USD 14,338/t, +0.28%; Oct 27 session copper around USD 14,370/t (SP Angel)

timeline.change: SMM 10-28晨会：LME 3M铜14,621美元/吨、铝3,250美元/吨，较10-27早报口径（14,338/3,085）再涨；北美废铜主力等级10-27单日+11美分/磅
timeline.text_en: SMM Oct 28 morning: LME 3M copper $14,621/t, aluminum $3,250/t, up from the Oct 27 briefing levels (14,338/3,085); North American clean copper scrap grades +11 cents/lb on Oct 27

timeline.change: LME 3M铜收14,140美元/吨（-1.5%），10月录得-1.8%月度下跌（6月以来首次）；世行《商品市场展望》（10-28）将2027铜价预测上调18%至13,000美元/吨（矿供应受限+电网/数据中心/电动车需求）。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper closed at $14,140/ton (-1.5%) on Oct 30; October posted a -1.8% monthly decline, the first since June. World Bank Commodity Markets Outlook (10-28) raised its 2027 copper forecast 18% to $13,000/ton (mine supply constraints + grid/data-center/EV demand).

timeline.change: LME铜10-19~23当周收14,232.5美元/吨维持历史高位；10-30沪铜主力108,050元/吨、国内1#电解铜现货约110,165元/吨、升水1,250~1,300元/吨（LME Insight 10-23、Mysteel 10-30）。
timeline.text_en: LME copper held historic highs at $14,232.5/t the week of Oct 19-23; Oct 30 SHFE main contract RMB 108,050/t, domestic #1 cathode spot ~RMB 110,165/t (LME Insight Oct 23, Mysteel Oct 30).

timeline.change: LME 2026 年 11 月合约 10-31 官方收约 14,230 美元/吨，维持历史高位
timeline.text_en: LME November 2026 forward official close ~$14,230/MT on Oct 31, staying at historic high
LME at $14,258/t on Nov-02 (intraday $14,349); Goldman raised year-end-2026 target to $14,700/t, sees ~950kt ex-US deficit; SHFE copper 2612 closed at RMB 107,810/t on Nov-02

timeline.change: SMM 11-03：LME铜收$14,325.5/吨（+1.38%），SHFE主力108,370元/吨，历史高位延续
timeline.text_en: SMM Nov 3: LME copper $14,325.5/t (+1.38%), SHFE 108,370 yuan/t, historic highs continue

timeline.change: LME三月铜11-03收14,036美元/吨（-2.15%，盘中13,883为8-19以来最低）；LME铜库存309,650吨创四个月新高；智利Cochilco上调2026/2027铜价预测至6.18/5.95美元/磅。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper closed Nov 3 at $14,036/ton (-2.15%, intraday $13,883 the lowest since Aug 19); LME copper inventories hit a four-month high of 309,650 tons; Chile Cochilco raised 2026/2027 price forecasts to $6.18/$5.95 per lb.

timeline.change: LME三月铜11-05收14,005.5美元/吨（-0.04%），11-03一度跌破14,000美元；LME铜总库存318,675吨，其中美国仓库223,300吨、占70.1%（2019年3月以来最高占比），背景为市场预期美国自2027年起对精炼铜进口征15%关税。
timeline.text_en: LME 3-month copper closed at $14,005.5/t on Nov 5 (-0.04%), briefly breaking below $14,000 on Nov 3; total LME copper stocks 318,675t, of which US warehouses held 223,300t (70.1%, highest share since March 2019), amid expectations of a 15% US tariff on refined copper imports from 2027.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-06 盘中跌破 14,000 美元，本周跌幅为 3 月以来最大；但上期所铜库存周降超 24%、创近 3 年新低，洋山铜溢价创纪录高位——期货跌、现货紧并存
timeline.text_en: LME 3M broke below $14,000 intraday on Nov 6, the biggest weekly drop since March; yet SHFE copper stocks fell over 24% w/w to a near-3-year low and the Yangshan premium hit a record — futures down, physical tight

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-06 收 13,780 美元/吨（-1.78%），再度跌破 14,000 美元，本周 -2.7%、创 3 月以来最大单周跌幅；沪铜主力 104,260 元/吨（-1.94%），现货升水 2,500–2,800 元/吨创年内新高，国内电解铜现货库存 6.74 万吨刷新年内新低——期货跌、现货紧并存
timeline.text_en: LME 3M closed at $13,780/t on Nov 6 (-1.78%), below $14,000 again, down 2.7% for the week, the largest weekly drop since March; SHFE copper fell 1.94% to 104,260 yuan/t, spot premiums hit a yearly high of 2,500-2,800 yuan/t and domestic refined-copper spot inventories hit a yearly low of 67,400 t — futures down, physical tight

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-06 收 13,768 美元/吨（7 月下旬以来最低收盘），全周跌幅 3 月以来最大；上期所库存周 -24% 至 33,848 吨、洋山溢价创纪录 217.50 美元/吨——期货跌、现货紧并存（11-08 期 13,780 美元为官方卖出价口径，本期改用期货收盘价）
timeline.text_en: LME 3M closed at $13,768/t on Nov 6, the lowest close since late July, with the biggest weekly drop since March; SHFE stocks fell 24% w/w to 33,848 t and the Yangshan premium hit a record $217.50/t — futures down, physical tight (the $13,780 in the Nov 8 edition was the official ask; this edition uses the 3M futures close)

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-09 收 13,880 美元/吨（+0.81%），周一反弹；洋山铜溢价创纪录 230 美元/吨、上海现货升水 2,615 元/吨创纪录、上期所库存 33,848 吨近三年最低
timeline.text_en: LME 3M closed at $13,880/t on Nov 9 (+0.81%), rebounding on Monday; the Yangshan copper premium hit a record $230/t, the Shanghai spot premium a record 2,615 yuan/t, and SHFE stocks 33,848 t, the lowest in nearly three years

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-09 收 13,880 美元/吨（+0.81%），11-10 盘中 13,939 美元/吨；洋山铜溢价持平纪录 230 美元/吨；上期所库存 33,848 吨、近三年最低、周降逾 24%
timeline.text_en: LME 3M closed Nov 9 at $13,880/t (+0.81%), intraday $13,939/t on Nov 10; Yangshan copper premium flat at a record $230/t; SHFE inventory 33,848 t, a near-3-year low, down over 24% w/w

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-09 收 13,896.5 美元/吨（+0.93%），11-10 回落至 13,679 美元/吨（-1.56%）；洋山铜溢价连续 3 日创纪录 230 美元/吨；沪铜现货升水 11-06 达 2,615 元/吨、创历史最高
timeline.text_en: LME 3M closed Nov 9 at $13,896.5/t (+0.93%), fell back to $13,679/t on Nov 10 (-1.56%); Yangshan copper premium at a record $230/t for a third straight day; SHFE spot premium hit a record RMB 2,615/t on Nov 6

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-11 收 13,817 美元/吨（+1.0%），洋山铜溢价持于 230 美元/吨纪录高位；沪铜现货 11-12 广东均价 108,560 元/吨（+190 元）、升水仍超 1,000 元/吨；永安期货称冶炼减产传闻发酵、11 月产量或继续下滑。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M closed Nov 11 at $13,817/t (+1.0%); Yangshan copper premium held at a record $230/t; SHFE spot copper in Guangdong averaged RMB 108,560/t on Nov 12 (+RMB 190), premium still above RMB 1,000/t; Yongan Futures cited smelter output-cut talk with November output likely to fall further.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-12 夜盘收 13,605 美元/吨（-1.37%），11-13 约 13,484.50 美元/吨、料创连续第五周下跌；洋山铜溢价 11-13 再创新高：仓单均价 285 美元/吨（+45）、提单 265 美元/吨（+35）；铜精矿 TC 指数 -247.68 美元/干吨纪录低位，SMM 预计 11 月精炼铜产量 108.2 万吨为年内低点。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper closed overnight Nov 12 at $13,605/t (-1.37%) and traded around $13,484.50/t on Nov 13, set for a fifth straight weekly loss; the Yangshan premium hit a fresh record on Nov 13, with warrants averaging $285/t (+$45) and bills of lading $265/t (+$35); the copper concentrate TC index fell to a record low of -$247.68/dmt, and SMM expects November refined copper output of 1.082 Mt, the year's low.

timeline.change: LME 3M 官方收盘约 13,544 美元/吨（当日净跌约 120 美元）；沪铜现货对 2611 合约升水已从 11-06 创纪录的 2,615 元/吨回落至 200–250 元/吨；2611 合约 11-16 最后交易日、11-17–18 交割；上海电解铜现货 108,955 元/吨（+500 元）。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M official close about $13,544/t (down about $120 on the day); the SHFE spot premium over the 2611 contract fell to RMB 200-250/t from a record RMB 2,615/t on Nov 6; the 2611 contract last trades Nov 16 with delivery Nov 17-18; Shanghai electrolytic copper spot RMB 108,955/t (+RMB 500).

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-13 官方结算 13,545 美元/吨，盘中跌破 13,500 美元创约 4 个月新低、将录得连续第五周下跌；沪铜现货对 2611 合约升水单日暴跌 500 元至 275 元/吨；洋山溢价 285 美元/吨再创纪录；上期所库存 27,642 吨（2023 年 12 月以来最低）；2611 合约 11-16 最后交易日、11-17–18 交割。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M settled Nov 13 at $13,545/t, dipping below $13,500 intraday to a roughly four-month low and heading for a fifth straight weekly loss; the SHFE spot premium over the 2611 contract plunged 500 yuan in a day to 275 yuan/t; the Yangshan premium hit a fresh record of $285/t; SHFE warehouse stocks fell to 27,642 t, the lowest since December 2023; the 2611 contract has its last trading day Nov 16, with delivery Nov 17-18.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-16 盘中约 13,251–13,264.5 美元/吨，较 11-13 收盘 13,588 美元/吨跌约 2.4%，创 4 个多月新低、三连跌；沪铜主力 2612 收 104,090 元/吨（-0.90%），上海电解铜现货 107,420 元/吨，现货对 2612 合约升水 3,400–3,500 元/吨（11-16 上午）；洋山铜进口溢价升至 290 美元/吨、创历史新高；上期所铜库存约 27,642 吨（11-13，2023 年 12 月以来最低）；2611 合约 11-16 为最后交易日、11-17 起进入交割。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper traded around $13,251-13,264.5/t intraday on Nov 16, about 2.4% below the Nov 13 close of $13,588/t, a more than four-month low and a third straight decline; SHFE main contract CU2612 closed at RMB 104,090/t (-0.90%), Shanghai spot electrolytic copper at RMB 107,420/t, with the spot premium over the 2612 contract at RMB 3,400-3,500/t (morning of Nov 16); the Yangshan copper import premium rose to $290/t, a record high; SHFE copper stocks were about 27,642 t (Nov 13, lowest since December 2023); the 2611 contract had its last trading day on Nov 16, with delivery starting Nov 17.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-17 盘中跌至 13,144 美元/吨、创 7 月 1 日以来新低；沪铜现货对 2612 合约升水 4,500 元/吨、洋山铜现货 13,635 美元/吨；上期所 2611 合约交割挤仓，可交割库存仅 2,270 吨、对应当月持仓 24,050 吨。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper fell intraday to $13,144/t on Nov 17, lowest since July 1; Shanghai spot premium vs Dec contract 4,500 yuan/t, Yangshan spot $13,635/t; SHFE Nov contract delivery squeeze with only 2,270t deliverable against 24,050t open interest.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-18 盘中跌至 12,640 美元/吨、约 7 个月新低；沪铜现货对 2612 合约升水 4,600 元/吨、洋山溢价 360 美元/吨双双创历史新高；上期所库存 27,642 吨为 2023-12 以来最低。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M fell intraday to $12,640/t on Nov 18, a roughly 7-month low; Shanghai spot premium vs the 2612 contract reached RMB 4,600/t and the Yangshan premium $360/t, both record highs; SHFE inventory of 27,642 t was the lowest since Dec 2023.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-18 收盘 12,471 美元/吨，单日暴跌 755.5 美元（-5.7%，19 个月最大单日跌幅），创 4 月 7 日以来新低；11-19 收 12,443 美元，自 9 月历史高点 14,875 美元已跌 16%；JHU 研究预测美国最早明年出现铜短缺。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M copper closed at $12,471/t on 11-18, down $755.5 (-5.7%, the largest single-day drop in 19 months) to its lowest since 4-07; it closed at $12,443 on 11-19, down 16% from the September record high of $14,875/t; a Johns Hopkins study predicts a US copper shortage as early as next year.

timeline.change: 沪铜主力 11-20 收 92,400 元/吨（-3.35%），本周累计跌 10,340 元（-10.06%，近十年最差单周之一）；LME 3M 收 12,526 美元/吨（+0.44%），日内曾触及 12,020 美元（近八个月新低）；国内 1#铜现货升水仍高达 6,580 元/吨，电解铜现货库存仅 5.48 万吨。
timeline.text_en: SHFE copper's most-traded contract closed at RMB 92,400/t on Nov 20 (-3.35%), down RMB 10,340 (-10.06%) for the week, one of the worst weeks in nearly a decade; LME 3M closed at $12,526/t (+0.44%) after touching $12,020 intraday, an almost eight-month low; Shanghai spot premium for No.1 copper remained high at RMB 6,580/t, with spot electrolytic copper inventory of only 54,800 t.

timeline.change: 沪铜主力 11-19 跌 5.07% 收 94,720 元/吨，11-20 再跌 3.35% 收 92,400 元/吨；LME 铜 Mysteel 口径 11-20 报 12,022.45 美元/吨（-4.02%），与 SteelMint 口径 12,526 美元有出入；SHFE 库存 27,640 吨（2023-12 以来最低）、中国精炼铜进口升水创纪录 360 美元/吨，现货仍紧。
timeline.text_en: SHFE copper fell 5.07% to RMB 94,720/t on Nov 19 and another 3.35% to RMB 92,400/t on Nov 20; LME copper was quoted at $12,022.45/t (-4.02%) by Mysteel, differing from SteelMint's $12,526; SHFE inventories hit 27,640t (lowest since Dec 2023) and China's refined-copper import premium hit a record $360/t, so physical supply stays tight.

timeline.change: 沪铜主力 11-20 收 92,400 元/吨（-3.35%），当周周线 -12.03%；LME 官方结算价 12,230.50 美元/吨（订正：Mysteel 12,022.45 美元为盘中低点）；洋山铜溢价 360 美元/吨创纪录；SHFE 库存 27,642 吨（2023-12 以来最低）；SMM 现货升水 11-19 达 7,250 元/吨纪录。
timeline.text_en: SHFE copper closed Nov 20 at 92,400 yuan/t (-3.35%), down 12.03% for the week; LME official settlement $12,230.50/t (correction: Mysteel's $12,022.45 was the intraday low); Yangshan premium hit a record $360/t; SHFE stocks 27,642 t, lowest since Dec 2023; SMM spot premium hit a record 7,250 yuan/t on Nov 19.

timeline.change: 沪铜主力收 92,420 元/吨（-1.01%）；SMM 上海 1# 电解铜现货升水均价 3,350 元/吨，较 11-20 大跌 2,450 元/吨；洋山铜溢价回落至 450 美元/吨；上期所铜库存 30,846 吨（+11.59%）；LME 铜 12,168 美元/吨（+0.1%）。
timeline.text_en: SHFE copper closed at 92,420 yuan/ton (-1.01%); SMM Shanghai #1 spot premium averaged 3,350 yuan/ton, down 2,450 from Nov 20; Yangshan premium eased to $450/ton; SHFE inventory 30,846 tons (+11.59%); LME copper $12,168/ton (+0.1%).

timeline.text_en: Samsung Q3 actuals land: operating profit KRW 107.4 trillion (+782.5%), a record; Nanya raised DRAM contract prices by up to 20% from Oct 7; Micron's Taoyuan plant union obtained strike authorization on Oct 7; DRAM contract prices up ~+400% since Sep 2025

timeline.change: 南亚科10-07起上调DRAM合约价最高20%（公司不予置评，工商時報10-07）；AMD苏姿丰10-06访台示警内存供应紧张；三星HBM4 2027年合约价格预计调高至2倍以上；摩根士丹利10-06：DRAM短缺将贯穿本轮AI产业周期
timeline.text_en: Nanya raised DRAM contract prices by up to 20% from Oct 7 (company declined to comment; Commercial Times, Oct 7); AMD's Lisa Su warned on her Oct 6 Taiwan visit that memory supply is tight; Samsung HBM4 2027 contract prices expected to more than double; Morgan Stanley (Oct 6): the DRAM shortage will run through this AI industry cycle

timeline.change: TrendForce 最新 Q4 合约价预测（约10月初）：传统 DRAM +10%~15%、含 HBM 整体 DRAM +15%~20%、NAND +15%~20%；美光称 2027 年内存供应已 75% 售罄；SanDisk 确认闪存配给延续至 2027 年后；SK 海力士批 54.3 万亿韩元建 Yongin 两座新内存厂、与微软/谷歌谈数百亿美元长期 DRAM 协议；三星 HBM4 定价谈判终段、寻求 2 倍以上 HBM3E 定价
timeline.text_en: TrendForce's latest Q4 contract-price forecast (early Oct): conventional DRAM +10%~15%, overall DRAM including HBM +15%~20%, NAND +15%~20%; Micron says 75% of 2027 memory supply is already sold out; SanDisk confirms flash allocation continues beyond 2027; SK hynix approved KRW 54.3 trillion to build two new memory fabs in Yongin and is in talks with Microsoft / Google on tens of billions of dollars in long-term DRAM agreements; Samsung's HBM4 pricing talks in final stage, seeking 2x+ HBM3E pricing

timeline.change: TrendForce：HBM 占三大厂 DRAM 晶圆投入 18%（2025 底）→22%（2026 底）→30%（2027 底）；DDR5 64GB RDIMM 价格翻倍、DDR4 涨 60~80%（DatacenterDisk 10-11）；三星 HBM4 谈判终段、寻求超 2 倍 HBM3E 定价；三星/SK 海力士/美光被诉 DRAM 价格操纵（原告指控、法院未认定，仅观察）
timeline.text_en: TrendForce: HBM's share of the big three's DRAM wafer input rises 18% (end-2025) → 22% (end-2026) → 30% (end-2027); DDR5 64GB RDIMM prices doubled, DDR4 up 60~80% (DatacenterDisk, Oct 11); Samsung HBM4 talks in final stage, seeking 2x+ HBM3E pricing; Samsung / SK hynix / Micron sued over DRAM price manipulation (plaintiff allegations only, not court-established — watch only)

timeline.change: 三星HBM4报价定在每Gb约4~5美元、约为HBM3E三倍；HBM将吃掉近30%全球DRAM晶圆产能；美光预警2027/2028年供需比2026年更紧张；手机存储芯片现货近3个月累计上涨超300%
timeline.text_en: Samsung HBM4 quoted at ~$4~5 per Gb, ~3x HBM3E; HBM will consume ~30% of global DRAM wafer capacity; Micron warns 2027/2028 supply-demand will be tighter than 2026; handset memory spot prices up 300%+ cumulatively over the past 3 months

timeline.change: 华强北内存现货一年涨超300%（DDR4 16G 100多元→600多元、DDR5 16G 200多元→1400元以上；深圳广电/界面10-07~08）；TrendForce预计Q4手机DRAM/NAND合约价+10%~20%（10-08）；余承东承认单机存储成本增加超200美元、后续不得不涨价
timeline.text_en: Huaqiangbei memory spot prices up 300%+ in a year (DDR4 16G from RMB 100+ to 600+, DDR5 16G from RMB 200+ to over 1,400; Shenzhen Media Group / Jiemian, Oct 7~8); TrendForce expects Q4 handset DRAM/NAND contract prices +10%~20% (Oct 8); Richard Yu acknowledged per-device memory cost is up by over US$200, making price increases unavoidable

timeline.change: 巴克莱（10-13）：DDR4合约价三个月累计+24%（单月+4%）、DDR5三月累计+20%；预计DRAM供需缺口2027Q4见顶（缺口率13.9%）、NAND缺口2028Q1见顶（8.3%）；摩根大通（10-14）：2027年HBM市场规模同比+149%至1600亿美元，美光2027年HBM价格锁定显著高于上年、FY2027超75%产出被长约锁定
timeline.text_en: Barclays (Oct 13): DDR4 contract prices +24% cumulative over three months (+4% in the latest month), DDR5 +20% over three months; expects the DRAM supply gap to peak in 2027Q4 (gap rate 13.9%) and the NAND gap in 2028Q1 (8.3%); JPMorgan (Oct 14): the 2027 HBM market grows +149% YoY to US$160B; Micron's 2027 HBM prices are locked notably above last year, with over 75% of FY2027 output locked by LTAs

timeline.change: 南亚科通知客户DRAM合约价再度上调最高20%（中国IC交易网10-7）；韩国专家10-15称当前存储市场供给缺口约30%~40%（中国IC交易网10-15）；巴克莱/摩根大通口径不变（DRAM缺口2027Q4见顶、缺口率13.9%）
timeline.text_en: Nanya notifies customers of another DRAM contract-price increase of up to 20% (China IC Trade Network, Oct 7); Korean experts said on Oct 15 the current memory market supply gap is ~30%~40% (China IC Trade Network, Oct 15); Barclays / JPMorgan views unchanged (DRAM gap peaks 2027Q4 at a 13.9% gap rate)

timeline.change: KeyBanc 10-16 上调预测：2026Q4 DRAM环比+15%~20%、NAND+20%，2027Q1 HBM环比+80%~100%；惠普/戴尔将存储供应协议延长至2031、谷歌洽谈至2035；三星Q4产量预测从3140万台下调至2420万台（-23%）、LPDDR5X价格同比+175%；美光台中新厂启用；长鑫4F2进展致10-16 SK海力士-5%、美光-3%（高盛称市场高估技术冲击，观察信号）
timeline.text_en: KeyBanc raised forecasts on Oct 16: 2026Q4 DRAM +15%~20% QoQ, NAND +20%, 2027Q1 HBM +80%~100% QoQ; HP / Dell extend memory supply agreements to 2031, Google in talks to 2035; Samsung's Q4 output forecast cut from 31.4M to 24.2M units (-23%), LPDDR5X prices +175% YoY; Micron's new Taichung plant comes online; CXMT 4F2 progress sent SK hynix -5% and Micron -3% on Oct 16 (Goldman Sachs calls the technology-shock fears overdone — an observation signal)

timeline.change: 南亚科通知客户DRAM合约价再上调、最高+20%（厂商端实际动作，公司不予置评）
timeline.text_en: Nanya notifies customers that DRAM contract prices are raised again, by up to +20% (an actual vendor action; company declined to comment)

timeline.change: 长鑫10-16业绩预告：前三季净利1310~1325亿元转亏为盈（AI需求+内存涨价+高产能利用率）；TechInsights/SK表态：产能释放需3年以上、短缺或持续至2030；CXMT占全球DRAM约8%、国内30%
timeline.text_en: CXMT's Oct 16 results preview: first-three-quarter net profit RMB 13.10~13.25B, swinging to profit (AI demand + memory price hikes + high capacity utilization); TechInsights / SK statements: capacity release takes 3+ years, the shortage may last to 2030; CXMT is ~8% of global DRAM and 30% domestically

timeline.change: 摩根士丹利上调2026Q4口径：DRAM合约价季增+10%~15%（此前+3~8%）、NAND+15%~20%、企业级SSD+23~28%，预测2027年HBM ASP年增121%；Nvidia Rubin VR200 NVL72 2026年出货预估<1万台（目标1.5万）、2027H2才成主流
timeline.text_en: Morgan Stanley raised its 2026Q4 view: DRAM contract prices +10%~15% QoQ (from +3~8%), NAND +15%~20%, enterprise SSD +23~28%; forecasts 2027 HBM ASP +121% YoY; NVIDIA Rubin VR200 NVL72 2026 shipments estimated at <10k racks (target 15k), becoming mainstream only in 2027H2

timeline.change: 苹果新任CEO Ternus 10-15《时代》专访称内存供应是'一场严重危机'、必须考虑所有选项；外界解读不排除采用中国产内存（传测试长鑫DRAM未定案、美7名参议员致函施压反对）；业界消息Q1三星/SK供iPhone低功耗DRAM价格分别较前一季+80%/+100%（鉅亨網10-19）；长鑫前三季预告营收2650~2700亿、净利1310~1325亿扭亏（10-16公告）；DRAM合约价环比涨幅逐季收敛（Q1+90~95%→Q3+13~18%）、长鑫2027年月产能目标上修至38~42万片（中华网10-18）
timeline.text_en: Apple's new CEO Ternus called memory supply 'a serious crisis' in an Oct 15 Time interview, saying all options must be considered; outside interpretation does not rule out Chinese-made memory (reported CXMT DRAM testing unconfirmed; 7 US senators wrote to pressure against it); industry sources say Q1 Samsung / SK LPDDR prices for iPhone rose +80% / +100% QoQ respectively (Anue, Oct 19); CXMT's first-three-quarter preview: revenue RMB 265~270B, net profit RMB 13.10~13.25B, swinging to profit (announced Oct 16); DRAM contract-price QoQ gains are converging quarter by quarter (Q1 +90~95% → Q3 +13~18%); CXMT's 2027 monthly capacity target revised up to 380~420k wafers (Zhonghua Net, Oct 18)

timeline.change: 三星HBM4谈判报价约4美元/Gb（HBM3E约1.5美元），涨超200%；DDR4 16Gb现货83.6美元倒挂DDR5 58.0美元（贵44%）；巴克莱：DDR4合约价10月环比+4%、三月累计+24%，DDR5三月累计+20%
timeline.text_en: Samsung HBM4 negotiation quote ~$4/Gb (HBM3E ~$1.5), up 200%+; DDR4 16Gb spot at $83.6 inverts above DDR5's $58.0 (a 44% premium); Barclays: DDR4 contract prices +4% MoM in October, +24% over three months; DDR5 +20% over three months

timeline.change: TrendForce 10-20：Q4 DRAM合约价季增约20%（Q2+80%→Q3+40%涨幅收敛）、NAND季增30%；英伟达评估Rubin Ultra改12-Hi HBM4e为8-Hi（同晶粒供给下GPU出货理论+约50%，每Gb成本高10%~20%）；长鑫4F2进展引发10-20存储股下跌（高盛称冲击被高估）
timeline.text_en: TrendForce (Oct 20): Q4 DRAM contract prices +~20% QoQ (gains converging: Q2 +80% → Q3 +40%), NAND +30% QoQ; NVIDIA is evaluating switching Rubin Ultra from 12-Hi HBM4e to 8-Hi (theoretically +~50% GPU output on the same die supply, at +10%~20% cost per Gb); CXMT 4F2 progress triggered an Oct 20 memory-stock selloff (Goldman Sachs calls the impact overestimated)

timeline.change: 集邦9-30研报预估Q4一般型DRAM合约+10%~15%、NAND+15%~20%（hutaodewang 10-21转述）；华强北DDR5 16GB 1,400~1,850元（一年前约450元）；服务器DRAM LTA大面积落地、2027年HBM基本锁定更高价格（TrendForce 10-7纪要）
timeline.text_en: TrendForce's Sep 30 report estimates Q4 general DRAM contract prices +10%~15%, NAND +15%~20% (relayed by hutaodewang, Oct 21); Huaqiangbei DDR5 16GB at RMB 1,400~1,850 (vs ~RMB 450 a year ago); server DRAM LTAs broadly landing; 2027 HBM largely locked at higher prices (TrendForce Oct 7 minutes)

timeline.change: Barclays 10-13报告：10月DDR4合约价环比+4%、近3个月累计+24%；DDR5环比+3%、3个月+20%；DDR4现货价格较DDR5倒挂约44%；预测2027Q4 DRAM需求超供应13.9%、2028Q1 NAND最大缺口8.3%（TechNews，10-13，B类研报口径）
timeline.text_en: Barclays Oct 13: October DDR4 contract prices +4% MoM, +24% over three months; DDR5 +3% MoM, +20% over three months; DDR4 spot at ~44% discount vs DDR5; forecasts DRAM demand exceeding supply by 13.9% in 2027Q4 and an 8.3% NAND shortfall peak in 2028Q1 (TechNews, Oct 13, Class B broker view)

timeline.change: TrendForce：2026 Q4 DRAM合约价格环比+20%（Q2 +80%、Q3 +40%，涨速放缓但处历史高位）；英伟达考虑Rubin Ultra HBM从12-high降至8-high（单GPU HBM容量-33%，同量DRAM芯片可多支撑50% GPU出货）
timeline.text_en: TrendForce: Q4 2026 DRAM contract prices +20% QoQ (vs +80% in Q2, +40% in Q3 — pace slowing but at historic highs); NVIDIA considering cutting Rubin Ultra HBM from 12-high to 8-high (-33% HBM per GPU, same DRAM dies supporting 50% more GPU shipments)

timeline.change: DDR5零售价格再次上涨，10月中旬32GB DDR5-6000零售约429-450美元；部分小厂商/独立装机商开始取消已接订单
timeline.text_en: DDR5 retail prices climbed again; 32GB DDR5-6000 around $429-450 in mid-October; some small vendors/independent builders began canceling accepted orders

timeline.change: TrendForce 10-20更新：Q4 DRAM合约价环比仍看+20%（增速放缓但未转跌）；英伟达若Rubin Ultra由12-Hi改8-Hi HBM，单GPU显存容量约-33%、同量晶圆可多供约50% GPU，但8-Hi每Gb成本预计比12-Hi高10%~20%（2027年）；2027年HBM均价+121%判断不变
timeline.text_en: TrendForce Oct 20 update: Q4 DRAM contract prices still seen +20% QoQ (slower growth, not a reversal); if NVIDIA switches Rubin Ultra from 12-Hi to 8-Hi HBM, per-GPU memory capacity falls ~33% while the same wafer supply could support ~50% more GPUs, but 8-Hi cost per Gb is expected 10%-20% above 12-Hi (2027); the 2027 HBM average price +121% call is unchanged

timeline.change: TrendForce口径DRAM交期20周、NAND 16周，约为常规8周的两倍；巴克莱预计DRAM需求超供给13.9%（2027年Q4）、NAND缺口峰值8.3%（2028年Q1）；南亚科称Q4涨幅放缓但不停涨，Fab 5A量产在2028年下半年之后（MT / TrendForce，10-15）
timeline.text_en: TrendForce puts DRAM lead times at 20 weeks and NAND at 16 weeks, about double the usual 8 weeks; Barclays expects DRAM demand to exceed supply by 13.9% (Q4 2027) and the NAND gap to peak at 8.3% (Q1 2028); Nanya says Q4 price rises will slow but not stop, with Fab 5A volume production only after H2 2028 (MT / TrendForce, Oct 15)

timeline.change: Sourceability Q3报告：美光部分技术交期达52周，企业级SSD多家分配制、交期24~52周且趋长；TrendForce口径DRAM 20周、NAND 16周延续
timeline.text_en: Sourceability Q3 report: Micron lead times reach 52 weeks for some technologies, enterprise SSDs on allocation from most manufacturers at 24-52 weeks and lengthening; TrendForce basis of DRAM 20 weeks / NAND 16 weeks continues

timeline.change: 三星10-29 Q3业绩会：Q3 DRAM ASP环比+20%、HBM4销量环比增3倍以上、2027年HBM产能已全部售罄、紧缺将延续；TrendForce展望Q4常规DRAM合约价+10%~15% QoQ、NAND +15%~20%。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Q3 call 10-29: Q3 DRAM ASP +20% QoQ, HBM4 sales up 3x+ QoQ, 2027 HBM capacity fully sold out; TrendForce sees Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices +10%-15% QoQ, NAND +15%-20%.

timeline.change: 三星Q3电话会：DRAM ASP环比+20%、NAND +10%，HBM4销量环比增3倍以上，Q4需求继续扩大。
timeline.text_en: Samsung Q3 call (10-29): DRAM ASP +20% QoQ, NAND +10% QoQ; HBM4 sales up 3x+ QoQ; Q4 demand to expand further.

timeline.change: 10月现货：通用DDR4 8Gb均价$27.50再创历史新高（环比+5.77%）；128Gb MLC NAND持平于$30.61，结束21个月连涨；TrendForce预计Q4 PC DRAM合约价+13~18%。
timeline.text_en: October spot: generic DDR4 8Gb averaged $27.50, a new all-time high (+5.77% MoM); 128Gb MLC NAND flat at $30.61, ending a 21-month rally. TrendForce sees Q4 PC DRAM contract prices +13-18% QoQ.

timeline.change: SK海力士Q3电话会：DRAM及HBM产能到2029年"近乎售罄"（含在谈LTA），供不应求延续至2030年。
timeline.text_en: SK Hynix Q3 call: DRAM and HBM capacity "nearly sold out" through 2029 (incl. LTAs under negotiation); supply tightness into 2030.

timeline.change: SK 海力士 Q3 电话会：DRAM 均价环比涨 20%+、NAND 涨 20%+，服务器 DDR5 销量环比 +40%；14 家大客户长约锁定 2027-28 逾半产能，DRAM/HBM 到 2029 年近乎售罄、短缺延续至 2030 年
timeline.text_en: SK hynix Q3 call: DRAM ASP up high-20s% QoQ, NAND up mid-20s% QoQ, server DDR5 sales +40% QoQ; 14 major customers' long-term agreements lock over half of 2027-28 capacity; DRAM/HBM effectively sold out through 2029, shortage extends to 2030

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb现货11-02报$61.48/片（30天+7.83%、同比+480%）；TrendForce口径Q4常规DRAM合约+10~15%、NAND +15~20%
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot at $61.48/chip on Nov-02 (+7.83% in 30 days, +480% YoY); TrendForce: Q4 conventional DRAM contract +10~15%, NAND +15~20%

timeline.change: DRAMeXchange/TheElec：DDR4 8Gb 10月均价$27.50创历史新高（19连涨、环比+5.77%）；128Gb MLC NAND持平$30.61（21个月来首次止涨）；TrendForce预计Q4常规DRAM合约+13%~18%、NAND +15%~20%
timeline.text_en: DRAMeXchange/TheElec: DDR4 8Gb Oct avg $27.50 record (19th straight gain, +5.77% MoM); 128Gb MLC NAND flat $30.61 (first flat in 21 months); TrendForce sees Q4 conventional DRAM contracts +13%~18%, NAND +15%~20%

timeline.change: Micron 10月财报：数据中心DRAM毛利率90%（一年前41%），CEO称2027、2028年比2026更紧；TrendForce：2027年九家云厂商将买走约1.02万亿美元内存≈当年全球内存市场96%。
timeline.text_en: Micron October earnings: data center DRAM gross margin 90% (vs 41% a year ago); CEO says 2027 and 2028 will be tighter than 2026; TrendForce: nine cloud vendors will buy ~$1.02T of memory in 2027, about 96% of that year global memory market.

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb现货61.66美元/颗（30日+8.13%、同比+484%）、DDR4 8Gb 47.59美元/颗（同比+856%）；Q4常规DRAM合约价预计环比+10-15%、NAND +15-20%；TeamGroup 11-02法说会称最严重短缺在2026Q4至2027Q2末、供需最早2028年下半年才平衡。
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot at $61.66 per chip (+8.13% in 30 days, +484% year on year), DDR4 8Gb at $47.59 (+856% year on year); Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices expected +10-15% quarter on quarter, NAND +15-20%; TeamGroup said on its Nov 2 call the worst shortage runs from Q4 2026 to end-Q2 2027, with balance only in H2 2028 at the earliest.

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb 现货 11-06 报 62.17 美元/颗，周度 -0.6%，为 12 周连涨 +16.7% 后首次周跌；DDR4 8Gb 周均 47.81 美元、周 -1.0%，连续第三周下跌；Q4 常规 DRAM 合约价仍预计 +10-15%
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot quoted $62.17 on Nov 6, -0.6% w/w, the first weekly dip after a 12-week +16.7% run; DDR4 8Gb averaged $47.81, -1.0% w/w, a third straight weekly decline; Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices still expected +10-15%

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb 现货 11-06 报 60.17 美元/颗，周均 61.06 美元、周 -0.6%，连续第二周回落；DDR4 8Gb 周均 47.81 美元、周 -1.0%，连续第三周下跌；Q4 合约价 +10–15%、NAND +15–20% 预期未变
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot was $60.17 on Nov 6, weekly average $61.06, down 0.6% w/w for a second straight weekly decline; DDR4 8Gb weekly average $47.81, down 1.0% w/w for a third straight week; Q4 contract prices are still expected up 10-15% for DRAM and 15-20% for NAND

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb 现货 11-03 报 61.50 美元/颗、持平；SK 海力士预计存储短缺延续至至少 2030 年，三星称 2027 年 HBM 产能已全部锁定；HBM3E 经销商报价约 4,000 美元/颗
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot was $61.50 on Nov 3, flat; SK Hynix expects the memory shortage to last until at least 2030 and Samsung says its 2027 HBM capacity is fully booked; HBM3E dealer quotes are about $4,000 per chip

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb 现货 11-09 报 61.51 美元/颗，持平高位（11-05 曾跌至 60.667）；TrendForce：Q4 合约仍预计 +10-15%、NAND +15-20%，现货买家观望、合约继续涨
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot was $61.51 on Nov 9, flat at the high (it had dipped to $60.667 on Nov 5); TrendForce still expects Q4 contract prices +10-15% for DRAM and +15-20% for NAND, with spot buyers holding back while contracts keep rising

timeline.change: DDR5 16Gb 现货 11-10 报 61.83 美元/颗（+0.53%）；TrendForce：Q4 常规 DRAM 合约仍预计 +10–15%、NAND +15–20%；32GB DDR5 套条现货 11 月初三天内 459→570 美元（+25%）
timeline.text_en: DDR5 16Gb spot at $61.83 on Nov 10 (+0.53%); TrendForce: Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices still expected +10-15%, NAND +15-20%; 32GB DDR5 kit spot rose $459 to ~$570 (+25%) within three days in early November

timeline.change: SK 海力士称 DRAM 与 HBM"有效售罄至 2029 年"、短缺预计持续至至少 2030 年；10 月 DDR4 8Gb 合约均价 27.5 美元（+5.77%）；TrendForce 预测 Q4 PC DRAM 合约价再涨 13-18%
timeline.text_en: SK Hynix says DRAM and HBM are "effectively sold out through 2029" with the shortage expected to last until at least 2030; October DDR4 8Gb contract price averaged $27.5 (+5.77%); TrendForce forecasts Q4 PC DRAM contract prices up another 13-18%

timeline.change: 三星称 2027 年 HBM 供应已售罄，SK 海力士已与客户敲定明年 HBM4 量价；DDR4 现货 11 月初报 46.31 美元（周 +2.55%、年 +856%）；TrendForce 预测 Q4 常规 DRAM 合约价再涨 10-15%、NAND +15-20%。
timeline.text_en: Samsung said 2027 HBM supply is sold out; SK hynix has agreed next year's HBM4 volume and pricing with customers; DDR4 spot printed $46.31 in early November (+2.55% WoW, +856% YoY); TrendForce forecasts Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices up another 10-15% and NAND up 15-20%.

timeline.change: TrendForce 11-12 称多家头部原厂已口头向渠道释放企业级颗粒提价意向（正式提价函尚未下发，渠道价已先动）；Q4 常规 DRAM 合约价预计 +10–15%、NAND +15–20%；SK 海力士 DRAM 与 HBM「实际售罄至 2029 年」；DDR4 现货周均 46.51 美元（周 -2.7%，连跌四周，仍处历史高位）。
timeline.text_en: TrendForce reported Nov 12 that several leading memory makers have verbally signalled a new round of enterprise-grade price increases to distributors (no formal letter yet, but channel prices have already moved); Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices are forecast +10-15% and NAND +15-20%; SK Hynix says its DRAM and HBM are 'effectively sold out through 2029'; DDR4 spot averaged $46.51 for the week (-2.7% w/w, a fourth straight weekly fall, still near historic highs).

timeline.change: SK 海力士称内存短缺至少持续至 2030 年，2027–2028 年过半产能已被长期协议锁定；Counterpoint 称 2026 年 Q3 全球 DRAM 收入同比 +369% 至近 2,000 亿美元；DDR4 现货 11-12 会话均价 44.714 美元（单日 -0.40%）。
timeline.text_en: SK Hynix said the memory shortage will last at least until 2030, with over half of 2027-2028 capacity already locked under long-term agreements; Counterpoint put global Q3 2026 DRAM revenue up 369% year on year to nearly $200 billion; DDR4 spot averaged $44.714 in the Nov 12 session (-0.40% on the day).

timeline.change: 美国 DRAM 反垄断诉讼 11-14 法官驳回三星、SK 海力士、美光三家驳回动议（案号 5:26-cv-06345-NW），三家须于 12-07 前提交答辩；DDR4 现货周均 46.51 美元、环比 -2.7% 连续第四周下跌；美光称已签 26 份战略客户协议至 2030 年、75% 以上 FY2027 出货已锁定。
timeline.text_en: A US federal judge on Nov 14 denied the motions to dismiss filed by Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron in the DRAM antitrust suit (case No. 5:26-cv-06345-NW); the three must file answers by Dec 7; DDR4 spot averaged $46.51 for the week, down 2.7% for a fourth straight weekly decline; Micron said it has signed 26 strategic customer agreements through 2030, with over 75% of FY2027 shipments already booked.

timeline.change: 10 月 DDR4 8Gb 平均合约价 27.5 美元（环比 +5.77%，创历史高位）；Q4 DRAM 合约价预计 +10%–15%；加州法院 11-14 驳回三家撤案动议，12-07 前答辩。
timeline.text_en: October DDR4 8Gb average contract price $27.5 (+5.77% m/m, record high); Q4 DRAM contract prices seen +10%-15%; California court denied the three makers' motion to dismiss on Nov 14, answers due by Dec 7.

timeline.change: 10 月 DDR4 8Gb 平均合约价 27.5 美元（环比 +5.77%，创历史高位、连续第 19 个月上涨），TrendForce 预计 Q4 PC DRAM 合约价 +13%–18%；但现货 DDR4 8Gb 11-17 报 44.25 美元（-0.24%）、已连续四周下跌，NAND 512Gb TLC 晶圆现货近一个月跌超 20%，合约与现货背离。
timeline.text_en: October DDR4 8Gb average contract price was $27.50 (+5.77% MoM, a record high and the 19th straight monthly rise); TrendForce expects Q4 PC DRAM contract prices +13%-18%; but spot DDR4 8Gb was $44.25 on Nov 17 (-0.24%), down four weeks running, and NAND 512Gb TLC wafer spot prices fell over 20% in a month, diverging from contract prices.

timeline.change: Q3 全球 DRAM 营收约 2000 亿美元（同比 +369%）；16Gb DDR5 合约价 48 美元（2025-10 为 8.70 美元）；美国 DRAM 集体诉讼继续推进（11-14 法院驳回撤诉动议，12-07 前答辩）。
timeline.text_en: Global Q3 DRAM revenue was about $200 billion (+369% YoY); 16Gb DDR5 contract prices reached $48 (vs $8.70 in Oct 2025); the US DRAM class action proceeds (court denied motions to dismiss on 11-14; answers due by 12-07).

timeline.change: TrendForce 11-18 首尔路演：Q4 通用 DRAM 合约价环比 +10%–15%、NAND +15%–20%，2027 年逐季续涨；HBM4 2027 年单价 3.00–5.50 美元/Gb（2026 年逾 2.05 美元，涨超 100%）；HBM 占三大厂 DRAM 晶圆份额从 23% 升至 2027 年近 30%。
timeline.text_en: At TrendForce's Nov 18 Seoul roadshow: Q4 conventional DRAM contract prices +10-15% QoQ, NAND +15-20%, rising further each quarter in 2027; HBM4 priced at $3.00-5.50/Gb in 2027 (over $2.05 in 2026, up more than 100%); HBM's share of the big three's DRAM wafer input rises from 23% to nearly 30% in 2027.

timeline.change: 闪迪 11 月 NAND 合约价上调约 50%（年内第三次），模组厂暂停报价与交货；TrendForce Q4 PC DRAM +13%–18%；联想称内存供应制约 AI 服务器交付。
timeline.text_en: SanDisk raised November NAND contract prices ~50% (third hike this year); module makers suspended quotes and deliveries; TrendForce sees Q4 PC DRAM +13%-18%; Lenovo says memory supply is constraining AI server deliveries.

timeline.change: TrendForce 11-19 大幅下调 NAND 预测：Q4 合约价涨幅由 +15%–20% 砍至 +8%–13%，1Q27 为 0%–-5%、2Q27 起转跌；通用 DRAM Q4 +10%–15% 不变；现货 512Gb NAND 晶圆 14.30 美元、季度 -32%。
timeline.text_en: TrendForce Nov 19 sharply cut its NAND forecast: Q4 contract-price gains cut from +15%-20% to +8%-13%, 1Q27 at 0% to -5% and falling from 2Q27; conventional DRAM Q4 +10%-15% unchanged; spot 512Gb NAND wafers $14.30, down 32% on the quarter.

timeline.change: 建滔10-13：薄布类板料/半固化片再+15%（年内第8轮）；工商时报10-22：玻纤布/CCL 11月起新一轮+10%~15%；证券日报11-03：松下通知部分多层板CCL自2027年1月起+200%；建滔1080规格玻纤布年内累计涨幅约300%
timeline.text_en: Kingboard Oct 13: thin-cloth laminates/prepreg +15% (8th hike this year); Oct 22: glass cloth/CCL +10%~15% from November; Nov 3: Panasonic +200% on multilayer CCL from Jan 2027; Kingboard 1080 glass cloth up ~300% YTD

timeline.change: 11月电子纱/布环比普涨（G75纱+3000元/吨至28750-28850、2116薄布+2.5元/米至20.2，卓创11-03）；供应链预计玻纤布+覆铜板11月再涨10%-15%；FR-4覆铜板交期从几天延至约4周；TPCA预计紧张延续至2027年。
timeline.text_en: November electronic yarn/cloth prices rose across the board (G75 yarn +3,000 yuan/ton to 28,750-28,850; 2116 thin cloth +2.5 yuan/m to 20.2, per Zhuochuang Nov 3); supply chain expects glass cloth + CCL up another 10%-15% in November; FR-4 CCL lead times stretched from days to ~4 weeks; TPCA sees tightness lasting into 2027.

timeline.change: 建滔积层板11-04新函：所有厚度FR-4覆铜板统一+10%、PP半固化片厚布+10%/薄布+20%；电子布11月2116薄布20.2元/米（环比+2.5元）、7628厚布14.6-14.65元/米（环比+1.5元）；FR-4覆铜板交期从几天延至约4周。
timeline.text_en: Kingboard Laminates issued a new notice on Nov 4: all FR-4 copper-clad laminates +10%, PP prepreg thick cloth +10% / thin cloth +20%; electronic glass cloth 2116 at 20.2 yuan/m in November (+2.5 month on month), 7628 thick cloth 14.6-14.65 yuan/m (+1.5); FR-4 CCL lead times stretched from days to about 4 weeks.

timeline.change: 松下通知客户 2027-01-01 起部分通用多层覆铜板 +200%；KCE 披露 Q3 玻纤布购入均价 0.95 美元/米，环比 +27.84%、同比 +87.64%，主因 AI 服务器优先占用产能；建滔第八轮 +15%（10-13）仍为最新一轮
timeline.text_en: Panasonic notified customers that some general multilayer CCL prices rise 200% from Jan 1, 2027; KCE disclosed Q3 glass-fabric purchase prices averaged $0.95/m, up 27.84% q/q and 87.64% y/y, mainly because AI servers take capacity first; Kingboard's eighth 2026 hike of 15% (Oct 13) remains the latest round

timeline.change: 生益科技 11 月起 M6 及以下板材 +15%、PP +25%（行业沟通信息）；松下通用多层板 2027-01-01 +200% 通知待经销商报价二次确认；建滔 11-04 新函仍为最新一轮，本窗口无第九轮
timeline.text_en: Shengyi raised M6-and-below laminates 15% and PP 25% from November (industry channel reports); Panasonic’s notice of +200% on general multilayer CCL from Jan 1, 2027 awaits distributor-quote confirmation; Kingboard’s Nov 4 notice remains the latest round, with no ninth round in this window

timeline.change: 松下新竹湖口厂火灾冲击高端 CCL 约 4% 供应、恢复或需数月；建滔 11-03 第七轮涨价函（FR-4 全系列 +10%）；生益 11 月提价传闻未证实
timeline.text_en: Panasonic Hsinchu plant fire hits about 4% of high-end CCL supply, recovery may take months; Kingboard's seventh 2026 hike notice on Nov 3 (FR-4 CCL +10%); Shengyi November hike talk unconfirmed

timeline.change: 11-01 新一轮涨价（M6 及以下 +15%、半固化片 +25%，两年最大单轮）；玻纤布 11-03 全面涨价（7628 厚布 +1.5 元/米）；生益称产能紧张、预计本月还有调整
timeline.text_en: New hike round from Nov 1 (M6 and below +15%, prepreg +25%, biggest single round in two years); fiberglass cloth prices up across the board on Nov 3 (7628 heavy cloth +RMB 1.5/m); Shengyi says capacity is tight and another adjustment is expected this month

timeline.change: 松下湖口厂 11-12/13 无官方新进展（11-05 口径：2 名失踪员工确认死亡，复产时间表未发布）；CCL 涨价已运行 4–5 个季度，招商证券调研称保守预期每月涨价持续至 2027-06；某 PCB 上市公司今年以来累计涨价约 30%（高端 +40%–50%）；电子布薄布紧缺或持续至 2027-06。
timeline.text_en: No official update from Panasonic's Hukou plant on Nov 12-13 (Nov 5 status: two missing workers confirmed dead, no restart timetable); CCL price hikes have run for 4-5 quarters, and China Merchants Securities research expects monthly increases to continue through June 2027; one listed PCB maker has raised prices about 30% this year (40%-50% on high-end products); thin glass-fabric tightness may persist through June 2027.

timeline.change: 生益科技称覆铜板产能紧张、今年以来产品一直在提价、预计本月还将有调整；高性能 CCL 采购周期 24–32 周（一般 8–10 周），106/1080/2116 玻纤布短缺，PCB 整体成本上涨约 30–50%。
timeline.text_en: Shengyi Technology said CCL capacity is tight, prices have risen all year and another adjustment is expected this month; high-performance CCL lead times run 24-32 weeks (8-10 weeks for standard grades), 106/1080/2116 glass fabric is short, and overall PCB costs are up about 30-50%.

timeline.change: 松下湖口（台湾新竹）厂仍无复产新进展；11 月电子布价格继续上涨（7628 电子布 14.4–14.8 元/米）；金安国纪 11-09 投资约 5 亿元在安徽宁国新建年产 1.3 亿米电子级玻纤布项目、计划 2027 年 3 月投产。
timeline.text_en: Panasonic's Hukou plant (Hsinchu, Taiwan) still has no resumption update; November electronic glass-cloth prices kept rising (7628 cloth at 14.4-14.8 yuan/m); Jin'an Guoji announced on Nov 9 a roughly 500 million yuan investment in a new 130-million-metre-per-year electronic glass-cloth project in Ningguo, Anhui, targeting production in March 2027.

timeline.change: 松下湖口厂仍停产（截至 11-10）；生益称 11 月还将调整；CCL 每月涨价节奏保守预期持续至 2027 年 6 月。
timeline.text_en: Panasonic Hukou plant still shut (as of Nov 10); Shengyi says another adjustment is expected in November; monthly CCL price rises conservatively expected to run to June 2027.

timeline.change: 松下湖口厂火灾后仍无复工消息（复工或需数月）；生益计划 11 月对 M6 及以下板材提价 15%、粘结片提价 25%，订单已排至 2027-01；建滔积层板年内第八轮涨价，薄布类板料与 PP 上调 15%。
timeline.text_en: Panasonic's Hukou plant still has no restart news after the fire (restart may take months); Shengyi plans November hikes of 15% on M6-and-below laminates and 25% on prepreg, with orders booked to Jan 2027; Kingboard raised prices for the eighth time this year, up 15% on thin-cloth laminates and PP.

timeline.change: 生益 11 月提价落地（M6 +15%、粘结片 +25%）；建滔第八轮（薄布板料与 PP +15%）；松下部分一般多层板用 CCL 自 2027-01 起调涨 200%（转述函件）。
timeline.text_en: Shengyi's November increases took effect (M6 +15%, prepreg +25%); Kingboard's eighth round (+15% on thin cloth and PP); Panasonic notified a 200% increase on some general multilayer CCL from Jan 2027 (reported letter).

events.title_en: New PCB/CCL price-hike wave (from Oct 5)

events.status_note: 5GW+长期供货协议签署（10-05）；弗吉尼亚Isle of Wight工厂细节落地：约6400万美元、352,000平方英尺、164个岗位、2027H1投产；10-19进展更新：43英亩、同步扩建韩国两座工厂

timeline.change: LG 与 AIR Control Concepts 签长期供货协议，为北美 AI 数据中心项目（5GW+ 容量）供应冷水机（HPAC/techtimes 10-05~06）；拟投资 1500 亿韩元（约 1.1 亿美元）在弗吉尼亚州 Windsor 建美国首座冷水机工厂，2027 年上半年投产；印度家用空调 10 月起涨价 5~7%（Moneycontrol 约 10-07）
timeline.text_en: LG signs a long-term supply agreement with AIR Control Concepts to supply chillers for North American AI data-center projects (5GW+ capacity) (HPAC / TechTimes, Oct 5~6); plans to invest KRW 150B (~US$110M) in Windsor, Virginia to build its first US chiller plant, production starting H1 2027; India residential AC prices up 5~7% from October (Moneycontrol, ~Oct 7)

timeline.change: 工厂细节落地：弗吉尼亚州Isle of Wight County（Windsor），投资约6400万美元（VEDP口径：超过6390万美元），工厂面积352,000平方英尺，创造164个新就业岗位，2027年上半年投产，生产AI数据中心用大型风冷离心冷水机组，属LG "Chip to Chiller"战略（Tidewater News 10-17；VEDP官方公告交叉核实）
timeline.text_en: Plant details land: Isle of Wight County (Windsor), Virginia; investment ~US$64M (VEDP basis: over US$63.9M); a 352,000 sq ft plant creating 164 new jobs; production from H1 2027 of large air-cooled centrifugal chillers for AI data centers, under LG's 'Chip to Chiller' strategy (Tidewater News, Oct 17; cross-verified with VEDP's official announcement)

timeline.change: 弗吉尼亚州Isle of Wight工厂进展更新（10-19）：350,000平方英尺、43英亩，2027H1投产不变；同时扩建韩国两座现有工厂（Database Trends and Applications 10-19）
timeline.text_en: Virginia Isle of Wight plant update (Oct 19): 350,000 sq ft on 43 acres, H1 2027 start unchanged; two existing Korean plants also being expanded (Database Trends and Applications, Oct 19)

timeline.change: LG 计划投资 6,400 万美元在弗吉尼亚州 Isle of Wight 县新建 HVAC 设备组装厂；就业人数、建设时间表与投产日期待官方确认。
timeline.text_en: LG plans to invest $64m in a new HVAC equipment assembly plant in Isle of Wight County, Virginia; headcount, construction timeline and start-up date await official confirmation.

timeline.change: LG 11-19 宣布组织架构调整：在 Eco Solution 事业部下新设 Applied Business 专责 AI 数据中心冷却，并新设弗吉尼亚冷水机组生产子公司；目标明年冷水机组年销售额 1 万亿韩元。
timeline.text_en: LG announced an organisational reshuffle on Nov 19: a new Applied Business unit under the Eco Solution division dedicated to AI data-centre cooling, plus a new Virginia chiller production subsidiary; it targets chiller sales of KRW 1 trillion next year.

timeline.change: 2026 年内第三轮调价 10 月落地（前两轮 4 月、7 月；9-1 预告函见上海证券报 9-03）；部分 AI 服务器电源管理料号（TPS/UCC）及高速信号链料号 10 月调价 15%~85%；部分料号交期延至 20~48 周；ADI 年内 2 轮调价（2-1、9-13 生效）、部分精密运放交期超 400 天（LinkedIn 供应链分析 ~9-23，单源市场分析口径）
timeline.text_en: The third adjustment round of 2026 lands in October (previous rounds in April and July; the Sep 1 advance letter per Shanghai Securities News, Sep 3); select AI-server power-management parts (TPS/UCC) and high-speed signal-chain parts adjusted +15%~85% in October; some parts' lead times extend to 20~48 weeks; ADI has made 2 rounds this year (effective Feb 1 and Sep 13), with some precision op-amps' lead times over 400 days (LinkedIn supply-chain analysis ~Sep 23, single-source market analysis)

timeline.change: 瑞银10-16研报：模拟芯片分销商库存环比-7%~-10%，True Analog均价环比+12%、Power Analog +9%、分立器件+34%；预计TI Q3营收环比+10.7%、ADI +8.5%、ON +5.4%（MarsBit 10-19转载）
timeline.text_en: UBS research (Oct 16): analog-chip distributor inventories -7%~-10% QoQ; True Analog average prices +12% QoQ, Power Analog +9%, discretes +34%; expects TI Q3 revenue +10.7% QoQ, ADI +8.5%, ON +5.4% (MarsBit relay, Oct 19)

timeline.change: TokenPost 10-19转述瑞银：Q3模拟厂营收增速超季节性（Microchip +8.5%），Microchip/onsemi库存175天/189天、补库尚未开始
timeline.text_en: TokenPost (Oct 19) relays UBS: Q3 analog makers' revenue growth beat seasonality (Microchip +8.5%); Microchip / onsemi inventories at 175 / 189 days, restocking not yet started

timeline.change: 10-22 Q3法说会确认2027年酝酿涨价（过去四年类比IC新增产能有限；2027年度议价进行中、供货保障成价格谈判条件）
timeline.text_en: Q3 earnings call on Oct-22 confirmed 2027 price-hike plans (limited new analog-IC capacity over four years; 2027 annual pricing talks underway with supply assurance as a bargaining chip)

events.title_en: TI analog third-round October price adjustment lands

events.status_note: 包钢/北方稀土Q4交易价38,769元/吨（环比+0.53%、同比+47.94%）高位企稳；氧化镨钕10-19约74.1万元/吨横盘；出口管制加码预期抬升永磁备货成本

timeline.change: 包钢股份/北方稀土 10-09 双双公告：2026 年 Q4 稀土精矿交易价格调至不含税 38,769 元/吨（干量，REO=50%），环比 +0.53%、同比 +47.94%；Q3 曾回落至 38,565 元/吨结束连续七个季度涨势，Q4 高位企稳；影响钕铁硼磁钢成本（证券时报/新浪 10-10）
timeline.text_en: Baogang Steel / Northern Rare Earth both announced on Oct 9: the 2026 Q4 rare-earth concentrate transaction price is set at RMB 38,769/t ex-tax (dry basis, REO=50%), +0.53% QoQ, +47.94% YoY; Q3 had dipped to RMB 38,565/t, ending seven straight quarters of increases; Q4 steady at highs; affects NdFeB magnet-steel costs (Securities Times / Sina, Oct 10)

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕10-10日价74万元/吨，较8月低点小幅回升；Q4精矿38,769元/吨高位企稳（新浪财经10-12）
timeline.text_en: Praseodymium-neodymium oxide at RMB 740,000/t on Oct 10, slightly recovered from the August low; Q4 concentrate steady at the RMB 38,769/t high (Sina Finance, Oct 12)

timeline.change: 湘财证券预计镨钕坚挺、镝铽偏弱，10月供应边际宽松压制价格上方空间（新浪财经/数据宝10-12、证券时报10-13）；氧化镨钕10-10报74万元/吨、Q4精矿38,769元/吨高位企稳格局不变
timeline.text_en: Xiangcai Securities expects praseodymium-neodymium to stay firm while dysprosium/terbium soften, with marginally looser October supply capping upside (Sina Finance / DataBao, Oct 12; Securities Times, Oct 13); praseodymium-neodymium oxide at RMB 740,000/t on Oct 10 and Q4 concentrate steady at RMB 38,769/t — pattern unchanged

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕10-13~10-16连续4日报74.0~74.5万元/吨（高位横盘）；Q4精矿38,769元/吨高位企稳（无状态变化）
timeline.text_en: Praseodymium-neodymium oxide held RMB 740,000~745,000/t for 4 straight days, Oct 13~16 (sideways at highs); Q4 concentrate steady at RMB 38,769/t (no status change)

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕10-19约74.1万元/吨横盘；稀土出口管制加码预期（"技术+物项"双重管制），抬高钕铁硼永磁电机/风机备货成本预期；北方稀土预计前三季度净利同比+135%~139%
timeline.text_en: Praseodymium-neodymium oxide ~RMB 741,000/t on Oct 19, sideways; expectations of tighter rare-earth export controls ('technology + items' dual control) raise stocking-cost expectations for NdFeB permanent-magnet motors/fans; Northern Rare Earth expects first-three-quarter net profit +135%~139% YoY

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕10-21约73.8万元/吨（-2,000）横盘（Mysteel 10-21）；状态无变化
timeline.text_en: Praseodymium-neodymium oxide ~RMB 738,000/t on Oct 21 (-2,000), sideways (Mysteel, Oct 21); status unchanged

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕报711,500元/吨（日降5,500，Mysteel）；稀土管制暂停包将于11-10到期，截至10月中旬无延期公告。
timeline.text_en: Praseodymium-neodymium oxide quoted at RMB 711,500/ton (-5,500/day, Mysteel) on Oct 30; rare-earth control pause expires Nov 10 with no extension announced as of mid-October.

timeline.change: 北方稀土Q4稀土精矿关联交易价38,769元/吨（环比+0.53%、同比+48%）；氧化镨钕10月下旬72~72.5万元/吨，较月中高点回撤2~3万（Mysteel 10-26~30）。
timeline.text_en: Northern Rare Earth Q4 2026 concentrate transfer price RMB 38,769/t (+0.53% QoQ, +48% YoY); praseodymium-neodymium oxide RMB 720k-725k/ton late Oct (Mysteel Oct 26-30).

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕 11-01 报 71.1 万元/吨（较 10 月中旬高点回落约 3 万）；N35 毛坯 185 元/kg 持稳
timeline.text_en: Pr-Nd oxide quoted RMB 711,000/ton on Nov 1 (down ~30,000 from mid-Oct high); N35 blank holds at RMB 185/kg

timeline.change: Mysteel 11-03：氧化镨钕701,500元/吨（-7,500），钕铁硼废料镨钕710-715元/kg（10月中旬755-765回落企稳），原料市场弱势运行、询盘冷清；北方稀土预计Q4镨钕价格以稳为主
timeline.text_en: Mysteel Nov 3: PrNd oxide 701,500 yuan/t (-7,500), NdFeB scrap PrNd 710-715 yuan/kg (eased from 755-765 mid-Oct), weak market; Northern Rare Earth sees stable Q4 PrNd prices

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕 11-09 报 707,500 元/吨（持平 11-06）；Mysteel 月报：10 月均价 73.2 万元/吨（-3.79%），11 月预计窄幅震荡阴跌；钕铁硼毛坯 35N 180 元/kg 持平
timeline.text_en: PrNd oxide was 707,500 yuan/t on Nov 9 (flat vs Nov 6); Mysteel monthly report: the October average was 732,000 yuan/t (-3.79%), with a narrow, slightly soft November expected; NdFeB blank 35N flat at 180 yuan/kg
Praseodymium-neodymium oxide at RMB 712,000/t on Nov 10 (+RMB 5,500; 707,500 on Nov 9); NdFeB blank 35N flat at RMB 180/kg

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕 11-12 报 715,000-718,000 元/吨（周环比上行），氧化镝 151-152 万元/吨连日走强，中重稀土领涨；Mysteel 氧化镨钕指数 716,500 元/吨。
timeline.text_en: Pr-Nd oxide quoted RMB 715,000-718,000/t on Nov 12 (up WoW); dysprosium oxide rose for consecutive days to RMB 1.51-1.52 million/t, with medium-heavy rare earths leading gains; Mysteel's Pr-Nd oxide index stood at RMB 716,500/t.

Praseodymium-neodymium oxide quoted RMB 717,000-719,000/t on Nov 13 (slightly up from Nov 12); dysprosium oxide RMB 1,520-1,530/kg and terbium oxide RMB 6,400-6,450/kg kept rising; praseodymium-neodymium metal RMB 870,000-875,000/t.
Praseodymium-neodymium oxide quoted RMB 717,000-719,000/t (RMB 697,000-700,000/t on Nov 4, up about 3% so far in November); dysprosium oxide RMB 1,520-1,530/kg, still rising.

timeline.change: 氧化镨钕 11-13 午后升至 718,000–720,000 元/吨，11-16 指数均价 719,000 元/吨；氧化镝 1,520–1,530 元/千克、氧化铽 6,400–6,450 元/千克；SMM 称上涨由供给端驱动、需求未跟上。
timeline.text_en: Praseodymium-neodymium oxide rose to 718,000-720,000 yuan/t on the afternoon of Nov 13, with the Nov 16 index average at 719,000 yuan/t; dysprosium oxide was 1,520-1,530 yuan/kg and terbium oxide 6,400-6,450 yuan/kg; SMM said the rally was supply-driven while demand lagged.
Praseodymium-neodymium oxide was RMB 722,000-724,000/t on Nov 18, averaging RMB 723,000/t (+4,000), up RMB 6,000/t from the Nov 16 average of RMB 717,000/t, a modest rebound.

timeline.change: 第一财经/日经亚洲 10-11 报道：苹果要求削减 iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max 10 月零部件订单至少 15%，原因为 DRAM 成本暴涨（1TB 版内存组件成本同比涨近 300 美元），内存已占旗舰机 BOM 一半以上；Nvidia DGX Spark 128GB 版从 $3,999 涨至 $6,950（+74%），归因 2026 年全球内存供应约束
timeline.text_en: Yicai / Nikkei Asia reported Oct 11: Apple asked to cut October component orders for iPhone 18 Pro/Pro Max by at least 15% on surging DRAM costs (1TB models' memory-component cost up ~US$300 YoY); memory now accounts for over half of the flagship BOM; NVIDIA DGX Spark 128GB rose from $3,999 to $6,950 (+74%), attributed to 2026 global memory supply constraints

timeline.change: Omdia：Q3全球智能手机出货同比-20%（内存成本致厂商砍低利润机型）；《财经》：小米/OPPO下调2026年整机订单超20%、vivo-15%、传音降至7000万台下；三星要求LPDDR季度涨幅超80%、SK海力士近乎翻倍（消息称）
timeline.text_en: Omdia: Q3 global smartphone shipments -20% YoY (memory costs pushing makers to cut low-margin models); Caijing: Xiaomi / OPPO cut 2026 full-unit orders by over 20%, vivo -15%, Transsion down to under 70M units; Samsung reportedly asks for 80%+ quarterly LPDDR increases, SK hynix nearly doubling (per reports)

timeline.change: 新任CEO Ternus 10-15《时代》专访称内存供应是'一场严重危机'、必须考虑所有选项；外界解读不排除采用中国产内存（传测试长鑫DRAM未定案、美7名参议员致函施压反对）；业界消息Q1三星/SK供iPhone低功耗DRAM价格分别较前一季+80%/+100%（鉅亨網10-19）
timeline.text_en: New CEO Ternus called memory supply 'a serious crisis' in an Oct 15 Time interview, saying all options must be considered; outside interpretation does not rule out Chinese-made memory (reported CXMT DRAM testing unconfirmed; 7 US senators wrote to pressure against it); industry sources say Q1 Samsung / SK LPDDR prices for iPhone rose +80% / +100% QoQ respectively (Anue, Oct 19)

events.status_note: CEO警告：平均交期115~130周、未提前锁定或等4年；10-20新数据：国内满产订单排到2027、美国交付50周→127周；美国单价2019年以来+45%~95%、中国对美出口+182%；未来3年投60亿美元、增聘15,000人扩产
events.title: Hitachi Energy CEO警告变压器供应不堪重负
events.title_en: Hitachi Energy CEO warns transformer supply is overwhelmed

timeline.change: Hitachi Energy CEO Andreas Schierenbeck对FT称数据中心需求使变压器产能跟不上：平均交期115~130周、未提前锁定或等4年；Rystad估市场规模2026年480亿美元→2030年670亿美元；Wood Mackenzie警告全球约25%可再生能源项目或因变压器交期延误；Hitachi未来3年投60亿美元、增聘15,000人扩产（DCD引FT约10-16）
timeline.text_en: Hitachi Energy CEO Andreas Schierenbeck told the FT that data-center demand is outrunning transformer capacity: average lead times of 115~130 weeks, or a 4-year wait without early lock-in; Rystad estimates the market grows from US$48B in 2026 to US$67B in 2030; Wood Mackenzie warns ~25% of global renewable projects could be delayed by transformer lead times; Hitachi will invest US$6B over the next 3 years and hire 15,000 people to expand capacity (DCD via FT, ~Oct 16)

timeline.change: 投资界披露变压器缺口新数据：美国变压器单价2019年以来+45%~95%、交期128~144周；中国变压器出口646亿元、同比+36%、对美出口+182%；取向硅钢自2020年约翻倍、铜价同期+50%以上；Newton-Evans：过去24个月超20家制造商在美新建/扩建27家工厂、新增产能2027~2029年释放
timeline.text_en: Pedaily discloses new transformer-gap data: US transformer unit prices +45%~95% since 2019, lead times 128~144 weeks; China's transformer exports at RMB 64.6B, +36% YoY, with exports to the US +182%; grain-oriented silicon steel roughly doubled since 2020, copper +50% or more over the same period; Newton-Evans: over 20 manufacturers built/expanded 27 US plants in the past 24 months, new capacity releasing 2027~2029

timeline.change: 央视财经10-20：国内变压器工厂满产、数据中心业务订单排到2027年；美国市场交付周期从50周延长至127周；中信建投10-19：7月美国变压器价格指数环比+4%
timeline.text_en: CCTV Finance (Oct 20): domestic transformer plants at full production, data-center order books scheduled into 2027; US market delivery cycles extended from 50 weeks to 127 weeks; CITIC Construction Investment (Oct 19): the July US transformer price index +4% MoM

timeline.change: SMM 10-17：10月取向硅钢缺乏上行动力、下游按需小单采购、补库意愿弱；变压器铁芯成本端暂无上行压力（与交期恶化/订单排到2027并存）
timeline.text_en: SMM (Oct 17): October grain-oriented silicon steel lacks upward momentum; downstream buys small orders as needed with weak restocking appetite; no upward pressure from transformer core costs for now (coexisting with worsening lead times / orders booked into 2027)

timeline.change: 美国大型电力变压器平均交付周期约128周（GSU发电机升压站约144周），2020年前仅需24~30个月；美国变压器单价比2019年上涨45%~95%；2026年美国计划投运约12GW数据中心中仅约三分之一在建、30%~50%预计延期（投资界pedaily 10月中旬深度报道，B类转述）
timeline.text_en: US large power transformer average delivery now ~128 weeks (GSU generator step-up ~144 weeks) vs 24-30 months before 2020; US transformer unit prices up 45%-95% vs 2019; of ~12GW of US data centers planned for 2026, only about a third are under construction with 30%-50% expected to be delayed (pedaily in-depth report, mid-Oct, Class B relays)

timeline.change: 快取新闻11-03转述经济日报：美国大型变压器交期长达2-3年（数据中心150-200MVA需求）；投资界10-19：中国变压器出口646亿元同比+36%、美国变压器单价较2019年+45%~95%、交期约128周
timeline.text_en: Cache News Nov 3: US large transformer lead times 2-3 years (150-200MVA data-center demand); Oct 19: China transformer exports 64.6B yuan +36% YoY, US unit prices +45%~95% vs 2019, ~128-week lead times

events.title: 美国对加Section 338清单调整：空调新纳入50%加征范围
events.title_en: US revises Canada Section 338 list: air conditioners newly subject to 50% duties

timeline.change: 特朗普10-23签署公告调整对加Section 338清单：胶合板、部分工业机械与包装纸品10-30起移出50%加征范围，空调新纳入加征范围；加拿大原产空调10-30起面临50%关税（另有诉讼挑战该措施合法性）（Supply Chain Dive，10-23）
timeline.text_en: Trump signed a proclamation on Oct 23 revising the Canada Section 338 list: plywood, some industrial machinery and packaging paper exit the 50% duties from Oct 30, while air conditioners are newly added; Canada-origin air conditioners face 50% duties from Oct 30 (a lawsuit challenges the measure's legality) (Supply Chain Dive, Oct 23)

timeline.change: 10-23特朗普签署公告、10-30生效：部分制冷设备移出50%加征清单（部分阀门加回）；涉加采购需按最新HTS编码核对。
timeline.text_en: Trump proclamation signed 10-23, effective 10-30: some refrigeration equipment removed from the 50% additional-tariff list (some valves added back); Canada-sourced procurement must verify latest HTS codes.

timeline.change: 新增窗式空调等HVAC品类：特朗普10-23签署修订公告（修订Proclamation 11048），window air conditioners、铁/钢阀（8481.80.30）等100个税号自10-30美东0:01起纳入50% Section 338关税（USMCA原产不豁免、可叠加232；22个税号移出）
timeline.text_en: Added window air conditioners and other HVAC items: Oct-23 revised proclamation (amending Proclamation 11048) puts 100 HTS lines including window air conditioners and iron/steel valves (8481.80.30) under 50% Section 338 tariffs effective Oct-30 00:01 ET (no USMCA exemption, stackable with Section 232; 22 lines removed)

timeline.change: 10-23特朗普签署公告第三次修订清单，10-30 00:01（美东）生效：空调设备/阀门/地毯/卧式冷冻柜新增50%从价关税，部分机械制冷设备移出；USMCA原产商品不豁免、可与232条款叠加。
timeline.text_en: Trump signed the third revision on Oct 23, effective 12:01 a.m. ET Oct 30: 50% ad-valorem duties added on air conditioners, valves, carpets and horizontal freezers; some mechanical refrigeration equipment removed. USMCA-origin goods not exempt; can stack with Section 232.

events.status_note: 10-30新版清单生效：阀门新纳入50%加征范围，冷冻设备等移出

events.title: Section 301 178项排除延至2027-01-09（原11-09到期）
events.title_en: Section 301 exclusions extended to Jan 9, 2027 (178 items; were due Nov 9)

timeline.change: 178项Section 301中国商品排除条款将于11-09 23:59（美东）到期，此后按清单税率恢复征收（Lists 1~3为25%、4A为7.5%）；进口商须核对报关行HTS行是否含9903.88.69/70（USTR 2025-12公告，Summit Sourcing/Airlift转述）
timeline.text_en: 178 Section 301 exclusions for China-origin goods expire at 11:59 p.m. ET on Nov 9, after which list rates resume (25% for Lists 1-3, 7.5% for List 4A); importers should check broker entries for HTS lines 9903.88.69/70 (USTR Dec 2025 notice, via Summit Sourcing/Airlift)

timeline.change: USTR 10-26在联邦公报发布征求意见提案：拟将海事港口费暂停延长至2027-01-09（意见截止10-30），该提案未定案；178项排除条款本身仍无延长通知、11-09到期不变；港口费暂停与排除条款同日到期
timeline.text_en: USTR published a Federal Register request for comments on Oct 26 proposing to extend the maritime port-fee suspension to Jan 9, 2027 (comments due Oct 30); the proposal is not final, and no extension notice exists for the 178 exclusions, which still expire Nov 9; the port-fee suspension and the exclusions lapse the same day

timeline.change: 截至10-31仍无延期公告：178项排除11-09（美东）到期进入倒计时8天；海事港口费暂停延期提案意见征集10-30已截止、仍未定案。
timeline.text_en: No extension notice as of Oct 31: 178 exclusions expire Nov 9 (ET), 8 days out; maritime-fee suspension extension proposal comment period closed Oct 30, still unfinalized.

timeline.change: 倒计时 7 天：截至今日 USTR 仍无延期公告；USTR 10-26 发布海事港口费暂停延期提案（拟延至 2027-01-09，征求意见 10-30 截止、尚未发布最终公告），提案不覆盖产品排除条款
timeline.text_en: 7-day countdown: no USTR extension notice as of today; USTR published Oct 26 proposal to extend maritime port-fee suspension to Jan 9, 2027 (comments closed Oct 30, no final notice yet); proposal does not cover product exclusions

timeline.change: 截至11-03 USTR仍无延期公告，倒计时6天；海事港口费暂停延期（拟延至2027-01-09）仍为提案、未定案
timeline.text_en: As of Nov-03 USTR has issued no extension notice, 6 days to expiry; maritime port-fee suspension extension (proposed to Jan-09-2027) remains a proposal, not finalized

timeline.change: ICPA 11-01/gatewaylines 11-02：截至11-02 USTR未发布任何延期通知；178项排除11-09 23:59 EDT到期，11-10起恢复清单全额税率；海事港口费暂停延期提案（FR Doc 2026-21755）评论期10-30已截止、仍未定案
timeline.text_en: ICPA Nov 1 / gatewaylines Nov 2: no USTR extension notice as of Nov 2; 178 exclusions expire 11-09 23:59 EDT, full List rates resume Nov 10; maritime fee suspension proposal (FR Doc 2026-21755) comment period closed Oct 30, still not final

timeline.change: 距11-09 23:59（美东）到期剩4天。本早报投递前复核联邦公报（截至11-05上午）：仍无延期文本；往年USTR常在到期前0-3天才公告。11-10起恢复全额301关税（清单1/2/3为25%、4A为7.5%）。
timeline.text_en: Four days left until the Nov 9 11:59 p.m. ET expiry. Rechecked the Federal Register before this briefing (as of the morning of Nov 5): still no extension notice; USTR has historically announced 0-3 days before expiry. Full Section 301 duties snap back on Nov 10 (25% for Lists 1/2/3, 7.5% for List 4A).

timeline.change: 距11-09 23:59（美东）到期剩3天。截至11-06上午复核联邦公报：仍无延期文本；往年USTR常在到期前0-3天才公告。11-10起恢复全额301关税（清单1/2/3为25%、4A为7.5%）。
timeline.text_en: Three days left until the Nov 9 11:59 p.m. ET expiry. Rechecked the Federal Register before this briefing (morning of Nov 6): still no extension notice; USTR has historically announced 0-3 days before expiry. Full Section 301 duties snap back on Nov 10 (25% for Lists 1/2/3, 7.5% for List 4A).

timeline.change: 截至 11-06 复核联邦公报仍无延期文本，剩 2 天；海事费用暂停延至 2027-01-09 的最终决定亦未发布
timeline.text_en: As of Nov 6 review, still no extension text in the Federal Register, 2 days left; no final decision published on extending the maritime fee pause to Jan 9, 2027

timeline.change: 截至 11-08 检索，USTR 仍未发布延长 178 项排除的通知；排除定于 11-09 23:59（美东）到期，剩 1 天；11-06 美财长贝森特与 USTR 格里尔同何立峰视频通话，要求中方“立即”落实釜山承诺；2025 年有 USTR 于到期当天宣布、过期后追溯发布的先例
timeline.text_en: As of Nov 8 checks, USTR has published no notice extending the 178 exclusions; they expire at 11:59 p.m. ET on Nov 9, one day out; on Nov 6 Treasury Secretary Bessent and USTR Greer spoke with He Lifeng by video, urging China to implement the Busan commitments 'immediately'; in 2025 USTR announced on the expiry day itself and published retroactively

timeline.change: USTR 11-06 发布两份通知：178 项排除延至 2027-01-09 23:59（美东），海事费用暂停同步延至同一日；仅延两个月，下次到期 2027-01-09；联邦公报刊登尚未确认
timeline.text_en: USTR issued two notices on Nov 6: all 178 exclusions extended through 11:59 p.m. ET Jan 9, 2027, and the maritime suspension extended to the same date; only a two-month extension, next expiry Jan 9, 2027; Federal Register publication not yet confirmed

timeline.change: 延期今日起适用：11-10 00:01 起报关/出库货物适用延期后排除；联邦公报刊登截至今晨仍未确认
timeline.text_en: The extension takes effect today: goods entered or withdrawn for consumption from 00:01 on Nov 10 use the extended exclusions; Federal Register publication was still unconfirmed as of this morning

timeline.change: 联邦公报 91 FR 72610（FR Doc. 2026-22925）11-10 已刊登，178 项排除延至 2027-01-09；CBP 报关指引截至 11-10 仍未发布；通知文本 1 月 9 日与 1 月 10 日表述矛盾，以 1 月 9 日为准
timeline.text_en: Federal Register 91 FR 72610 (FR Doc. 2026-22925) published Nov 10, 178 exclusions extended to Jan 9, 2027; CBP entry instructions still unpublished as of Nov 10; the notice text contradicts itself on Jan 9 vs Jan 10, Jan 9 prevails

timeline.change: 习特会釜山达成协议（10-30）：美对华关税57%→47%（芬太尼相关税率降至10%），中方暂停本月出台的稀土出口管制一年、恢复大豆采购，双方同意互停对等港口费措施；领导人公开宣布，实施细节待落实。
timeline.text_en: Trump-Xi Busan summit deal (10-30): US tariffs on China 57%→47% (fentanyl-related to 10%), China pauses this month's rare-earth export controls for one year and resumes soybean purchases, both sides suspend reciprocal port fees; announced publicly by leaders, implementation details pending.

timeline.change: 11-06 美财长贝森特与 USTR 格里尔同何立峰视频通话，要求中方立即全面落实釜山承诺，重点点名稀土、其他关键矿产与农产品采购；美方称中方仅履行约三分之二稀土承诺（FT 9 月口径转述）
timeline.text_en: On Nov 6 Bessent and Greer spoke with He Lifeng by video, urging China to implement the Busan commitments immediately, singling out rare earths, other critical minerals and farm purchases; the US side said China has fulfilled only about two-thirds of its rare-earth pledges (FT September wording, as relayed)

timeline.change: 中方 11-09 落实釜山安排一揽子延期：稀土管制暂停延至 2027-01-10、对美加征 24% 关税暂停再延两月、美籍船舶特别港务费暂停延至 2027-01-10、韩华海洋关联制裁暂停延两月；商务部短声明未给更多细节
timeline.text_en: On Nov 9 China rolled out a package of Busan-arrangement extensions: the rare-earth control pause to Jan 10, 2027, the suspension of the additional 24% tariff on US imports for two more months, the suspension of special port fees on US-linked ships to Jan 10, 2027, and the sanctions suspension for Hanwha Ocean affiliates for two months; MOFCOM gave no further details in its short statement

timeline.change: 国务院关税税则委员会第 6 号公告：对美加征 24% 关税暂停再延两月（11-10 13:01 起）、10% 保留；BIS 关联方规则暂停延至 2027-01-10（91 FR 70789）
timeline.text_en: Tariff Commission Announcement No. 6: 24% additional tariff on US goods paused for another two months (from 13:01 Nov 10), 10% retained; BIS affiliates-rule pause extended to Jan 10, 2027 (91 FR 70789)

timeline.change: USTR 11-11/12 确认 301 海运费暂停延至 2027-01-09（中国籍船舶及中国建造船舶相关服务费、岸桥等货物装卸设备附加关税继续暂停）；中方对等港口费暂停延至 2027-01-10；178 项 301 排除延至 2027-01-09（联邦公报 91 FR 72610）。
timeline.text_en: USTR confirmed on Nov 11-12 that the Section 301 maritime fee suspension runs through Jan 9, 2027 (service fees on China-linked vessels and additional duties on ship-to-shore cranes and other cargo-handling equipment stay suspended); China's reciprocal port-fee suspension runs through Jan 10, 2027; the 178 Section 301 exclusions run through Jan 9, 2027 (Federal Register 91 FR 72610).

timeline.change: 距暂停到期5天。2025-10-09六项公告（55/56/57/58/61/62号，含0.1%域外规则）暂停至2026-11-10；商务部9-28称中美休战延至2027-01-10但声明未点名稀土；截至10-16商务部公告清单无延长70号公告的文本。2025-04-04第18号公告7种重稀土从未暂停、持续生效，许可证审查约4个月；8月稀土出口量同比-18.2%。
timeline.text_en: Five days to the pause expiry. The six Oct 9 2025 announcements (Nos. 55/56/57/58/61/62, incl. the 0.1% extraterritorial rule) were suspended until Nov 10 2026; MOFCOM said Sep 28 the US-China truce runs to Jan 10 2027 but did not name rare earths; as of Oct 16 no text extending Announcement No. 70 appeared in MOFCOM notices. The Apr 4 2025 Announcement No. 18 (7 heavy rare earths) was never suspended and stays in force, with license reviews taking ~4 months; August rare-earth exports fell 18.2% YoY.

timeline.change: 距11-10暂停到期剩4天，截至11-05仍无续期法律文本；商务部9-28称中美休战延至2027-01-10但未点名稀土、未修订第70号公告。氧化镨钕11-05报711,000元/吨（+10,000），10月下旬下行后小幅回稳。
timeline.text_en: Four days left until the Nov 10 suspension expiry; as of Nov 5 no renewal legal text exists. MOFCOM said on Sep 28 the truce extends to Jan 10, 2027 but did not name rare earths or amend Notice No. 70. Praseodymium-neodymium oxide was 711,000 yuan/t on Nov 5 (+10,000), stabilizing after a late-October slide.

timeline.change: 截至 11-06 仍无修订第 70 号公告的法律文本，剩 3 天；贝森特称釜山休战覆盖稀土、延至 2027-01-10，但未见正式文本；氧化镨钕 11-05 报 711,000 元/吨（+10,000）
timeline.text_en: As of Nov 6, still no legal text amending Announcement No. 70, 3 days left; Bessent says the Busan truce covers rare earths through Jan 10, 2027, but no formal text seen; praseodymium-neodymium oxide quoted 711,000 yuan/t on Nov 5 (+10,000)

timeline.change: 11-06 美财长贝森特与 USTR 格里尔同何立峰视频通话，要求中方立即全面落实釜山承诺、重点点名稀土；美方称中方仅履行约三分之二稀土承诺（FT 9 月口径转述）；第 70 号公告法定到期日仍为 11-10，未见修订文本；氧化镨钕 11-06 均价 707,500 元/吨（-3,500）
timeline.text_en: On Nov 6 Bessent and Greer spoke with He Lifeng by video, urging China to fully implement the Busan commitments immediately, singling out rare earths; the US side said China has fulfilled only about two-thirds of its rare-earth pledges (FT September wording, as relayed); Announcement No. 70 still legally expires Nov 10 with no amendment text; praseodymium-neodymium oxide averaged 707,500 yuan/t on Nov 6 (-3,500)

timeline.change: 截至 11-09 上午仍无修订第 70 号公告的法律文本；商务部 11-06 回应仅确认暂停至 11-10；氧化镨钕 11-06 均价 707,500 元/吨（-3,500）
timeline.text_en: As of the morning of Nov 9, still no legal text amending Announcement No. 70; MOFCOM said on Nov 6 only that the suspension runs to Nov 10; praseodymium-neodymium oxide averaged RMB 707,500/t on Nov 6 (-3,500)

timeline.change: 商务部 11-09 宣布暂停期延至 2027-01-10：六项 2025-10-09 公告（55-58 号、61-62 号）11-11 至 2027-01-10 继续暂停；4 月七种中重稀土许可制从未暂停、持续生效；美方 11-06 曾称中方仅履行约三分之二釜山稀土承诺
timeline.text_en: MOFCOM announced on Nov 9 the pause is extended to Jan 10, 2027: the six Oct 9, 2025 announcements stay suspended Nov 11, 2026-Jan 10, 2027; the April 2025 licensing regime for seven medium-heavy rare earths was never suspended; on Nov 6 the US side said China had met only about two-thirds of its Busan rare-earth commitments
MOFCOM/GACC Announcement No. 58 (Nov 9): six Oct 9, 2025 rare-earth export controls remain paused from Nov 11 to Jan 10, 2027; praseodymium-neodymium oxide at RMB 712,000/t on Nov 10 (+RMB 5,500)

Praseodymium-neodymium oxide at RMB 720,000-723,000/t on Nov 11 (RMB 715,000-720,000/t on Nov 10), recovering from the Nov 4 low of RMB 697,000-700,000/t; Mysteel expects a slight Q4 softening, watching RMB 680,000-700,000/t support

Praseodymium-neodymium oxide was quoted at RMB 716,000-718,000/t on Nov 16 (average RMB 717,000/t, down 2,000), well below the above-RMB 740,000/t highs of mid-October; dysprosium oxide at RMB 1,540-1,550/kg and terbium oxide at RMB 6,450-6,500/kg; multiple rare-earth export controls remain paused from Nov 11 through January 10, 2027.

timeline.change: Vertiv 11-02 宣布液冷生态方案：扩展 Dow 合作、新增 Solenis 合作，液冷竞争从部件转向系统运维能力

timeline.change: Vertiv 推出 AI 规模液冷全球生态，扩大与 Dow 的合作（Dow Coolant Care Network）并新结盟 Solenis，整合热管理基础设施、冷却液/流体健康监测与全生命周期服务。

events.title: 谷歌接手 Crusoe 怀俄明数据中心项目、投 170 亿美元

timeline.text_en: Google took over Crusoe's Wyoming data center site (originally planned to scale to 10 GW) and announced a $17B investment to develop the campus; Crusoe remains Google's developer for the Armstrong County, Texas campus (BlockWest, Nov 7)

timeline.change: 首期 702MW 燃料电池电站（AEP 承建、Bloom Energy 供货）；Crusoe 11-06 确认已将该场地出售给谷歌（价格未披露）
