events.title: 印度天然橡胶触及 300 卢比/kg 历史新高
events.title_en: Indian natural rubber hits record INR 300/kg

timeline.change: 印度 RSS-4 天然橡胶 11-02 触及 300 卢比/kg 历史新高（同比 +62%）；印度轮胎制造商协会 ATMA 11-06 正式要求政府以关税配额方式临时免税进口，点名软管、密封件、传送带同受影响
timeline.text_en: Indian RSS-4 natural rubber hit a record INR 300/kg on Nov 2 (+62% y/y); the Automotive Tyre Manufacturers’ Association (ATMA) formally asked the government on Nov 6 for a temporary duty-free import quota, noting hoses, seals and conveyor belts are also affected

timeline.change: 沪胶 RU2701 11-04 收 18,865 元/吨（-1.92%），较 10-12 高点 21,005 回撤超 10%；但原料端仍处历史高位：科特迪瓦 11 月原料价 578 西非法郎/kg（同比 +66.6%）再创历史新高；ANRPC 预计 2026 全球天然橡胶供需缺口约 31.7 万吨
timeline.text_en: SHFE rubber RU2701 closed at 18,865 yuan/t on Nov 4 (-1.92%), more than 10% below the Oct 12 high of 21,005; raw material prices remain at record highs - Cote d’Ivoire November feedstock at 578 CFA francs/kg (+66.6% y/y), another record; ANRPC expects a global natural rubber deficit of about 317,000 t in 2026

SHFE rubber futures (RU2701) closed Nov 11 at RMB 19,475/t (+RMB 675, +3.62%), a third straight daily gain totalling over 1,100 points; Qingdao natural rubber stocks were 547,600 t (-2.57% w/w) and bonded stocks only 42,200 t (-12.05%); China's October natural and synthetic rubber imports were 553,000 t (-17.1% y/y).

timeline.change: 印度轮胎协会 11-06 要求临时免税进口配额；ANRPC 预计 2026 年全球产量 1,503.9 万吨、消费 1,535.6 万吨，存在供应缺口。
timeline.text_en: India tyre association ATMA on Nov 6 asked for a temporary duty-free import quota; ANRPC expects 2026 global output of 15.039 million tonnes against consumption of 15.356 million tonnes, a supply gap.

events.title: 松下台湾新竹湖口厂火灾冲击高端CCL供应
events.title_en: Panasonic Hsinchu plant fire hits high-end CCL supply

timeline.change: 11-04 火灾后续：2 名失踪员工确认死亡、5 人受伤；该厂产 MEGTRON 高端超低损耗 CCL（M6/M7/M8），TrendForce 11-05 评估约影响全球高端 CCL 供应约 4%，恢复期或需数月，订单或转向台系 CCL 厂
timeline.text_en: Follow-up to the Nov 4 fire: 2 missing workers confirmed dead, 5 injured; the plant makes MEGTRON high-end ultra-low-loss CCL (M6/M7/M8). TrendForce (Nov 5) estimates about 4% of global high-end CCL supply affected, recovery may take months, orders may shift to Taiwan CCL makers

timeline.change: 本期确认：复工需数月以上，松下正协调日本/中国/泰国基地替代供应；台系 CCL 股 11-05 反跌停（台光电、台燿、联茂、腾辉齐跌停）
timeline.text_en: Confirmed this issue: restart will take months; Panasonic is coordinating alternative supply from its Japan/China/Thailand bases; Taiwan CCL stocks hit limit-down on Nov 5 (EMC, TUC, ITEQ, Ventec all down)

events.title: KEMET钽电容第二轮涨价（11-01生效）
events.title_en: KEMET tantalum capacitor second price hike (effective Nov 1)

timeline.change: KEMET T520/T521/T530 系列 11-01 起 +20%~30%，年内第二轮调价，且扩至直供客户；松下跟进聚合物钽电容 +15%~30%、二氧化锰型 +10%~20%，部分聚合物钽电容最长交期 84 周
timeline.text_en: KEMET T520/T521/T530 series +20%-30% from Nov 1, second hike this year, extended to direct customers; Panasonic followed with polymer tantalum +15%-30% and MnO2 type +10%-20%, longest lead time for some polymer tantalum capacitors 84 weeks

events.title: 美国钢板供应紧张、交期排进2027年
events.title_en: US steel sheet supply tight, lead times into 2027

timeline.change: SMU 11-03：板材价格飙升、现货几乎无货、交期已排进 2027 年；Nucor 11-09 热轧卷现货价上调至 1,295 美元/短吨；Marino\WARE 钢产品自 2027-01-04 起再涨最低 10%
timeline.text_en: SMU (Nov 3): sheet prices surging, spot nearly unavailable, lead times into 2027; Nucor raised HRC spot price to $1,295/short ton on Nov 9; Marino\WARE steel products up at least 10% from Jan 4, 2027

timeline.change: 热轧现货超 1,450 美元/吨、创 4 年半新高；Steel Warehouse 11 月热轧报 1,326 美元/吨（上月 1,260）；SMU 板材交期延至 2027 年 1-2 月（2021 年后最长）；中钢 12 月涨价 NT$300/吨
timeline.text_en: Hot-rolled coil spot above $1,450/t, a 4.5-year high; Steel Warehouse November HRC at $1,326/t (vs $1,260 last month); SMU sheet lead times extended to Jan-Feb 2027 (longest since 2021); China Steel raising December prices by NT$300/t

timeline.change: Nucor 热轧 11-09 再涨 15 美元/短吨（连续第 17 周上调，CSP 至 1,295 美元/短吨）；板材 11-13 宣布 +70 美元/短吨并开启 12 月订货，SMU 板材均价 1,550 美元/短吨（周 +55）；232 条款 50% 关税封堵进口，板材交期已进入 2027 年。
timeline.text_en: Nucor raised hot-rolled coil by $15/st on Nov 9 (a 17th consecutive weekly increase, CSP $1,295/st); plate rose $70/st on Nov 13 with December bookings opened, and the SMU plate average reached $1,550/st (+$55 w/w); Section 232's 50% tariffs block imports, and plate lead times have moved into 2027.

timeline.change: Nucor 中厚板拟涨 70 美元/短吨、同时开放 12 月订单簿，订单须 11 月 27 日前提交；SMU 中厚板均价截至 11-10 为 1,550 美元/短吨（周涨 55 美元）；热卷 CSP 11-9 为 1,295 美元/短吨（周涨 15 美元）。
timeline.text_en: Nucor plans a $70/short-ton plate increase and opened its December order book, with orders due by Nov 27; SMU plate averaged $1,550/short ton through Nov 10 (+$55 on the week); hot-rolled CSP was $1,295/short ton on Nov 9 (+$15 on the week).

timeline.change: Nucor 11-13 板材再涨 70 美元/短吨并开启 12 月订货（订单须 11-27 前提交）；板材均价 1,550 美元/短吨、热卷 1,375 美元/短吨（11-10）；交期 3–5 周；截至 11-14/15 未见其他钢厂跟进。
timeline.text_en: Nucor raised plate prices another $70/short ton on Nov 13 and opened its December order book (orders due by Nov 27); plate averaged $1,550/short ton and hot-rolled coil $1,375/short ton as of Nov 10; lead times are 3-5 weeks; no other mill had followed as of Nov 14-15.

timeline.change: Nucor 热卷消费者现货价（CSP）11-16 再涨 15 美元/短吨至 1,310 美元/短吨（自 2025-08-25 以来连续 64 周持有或上调，累计 +435 美元/短吨），交期 3–5 周；板材 11-13 +70 美元/短吨后，截至 11-16 未见 Cleveland-Cliffs、U.S. Steel、SSAB 等跟进的公开宣布；SMU 板材均价截至 11-10 为 1,550 美元/短吨（周涨 55 美元）、热卷 1,375 美元/短吨（周涨 25 美元）。
timeline.text_en: Nucor raised its hot-rolled coil consumer spot price by $15/short ton to $1,310 on Nov 16 (the 64th straight week of holding or raising since Aug 25, 2025, up $435 cumulatively), with lead times of 3-5 weeks; after the Nov 13 plate increase of $70/short ton, no other mills had publicly followed as of Nov 16; SMU assessed plate at $1,550/short ton as of Nov 10 (+$55 week on week) and hot-rolled coil at $1,375/short ton (+$25).

timeline.change: Nucor 热卷 CSP 11-16 再涨 15 美元/短吨至 1,310 美元/短吨（连续第 18 周上调），中厚板 11-13 +70 美元/短吨并开启 12 月订货；国内热卷 11-17 全国均价 3,175 元/吨（-27 元/吨），续跌。
timeline.text_en: Nucor raised its hot-rolled coil CSP by $15/short ton to $1,310 on Nov 16, the 18th straight weekly increase, and plate by $70/short ton on Nov 13 with December order books open; China's domestic HRC average fell RMB 27/t to RMB 3,175/t on Nov 17.

timeline.change: Nucor 热卷 CSP 11-16 再涨 15 美元/短吨至 1,310 美元/短吨（连续第 18 周上调）；SMU 现货热卷均价 1,390 美元/短吨（11-17），镀锌板供应紧张、交期约 12 周或更长。
timeline.text_en: Nucor raised HR coil CSP by $15/st to $1,310/st on 11-16 (18th straight weekly increase); SMU spot HR coil averaged $1,390/st (11-17), with galvanized sheet tight and lead times of about 12 weeks or longer.

timeline.change: Nucor 热卷本周现货价 1,330 美元/短吨（+20 美元），连续第 18 周上调，交期 3–5 周；Dimensional Metals 钢板/卷 +4%–5% 自 11-23 生效。
timeline.text_en: Nucor hot-rolled coil spot price $1,330/short ton this week (+$20), the 18th consecutive weekly increase, lead time 3-5 weeks; Dimensional Metals sheet/coil +4%-5% effective Nov 23.

events.title: 江森自控×Armada 都柏林模块化 AI 数据中心投产
events.title_en: Johnson Controls x Armada start modular AI data center production in Dublin

timeline.change: 江森自控与 Armada 在都柏林 Galleon Forge Two 工厂开始连续生产模块化 AI 数据中心 Leviathan，首台已发往挪威 Fossefall，首批 5 台合计超 9MW、2027 年一季度前交付，双方目标 2027 年产能至少 500MW
timeline.text_en: Johnson Controls and Armada began continuous production of the modular AI data center Leviathan at the Galleon Forge Two plant in Dublin; the first unit shipped to Fossefall, Norway, with the first batch of 5 units totaling over 9MW due before end-Q1 2027 and a joint target of at least 500MW capacity in 2027

timeline.change: Armada×JCI 都柏林 Galleon Forge Two 投产：9 万平方英尺工厂开始连续生产，首台 Leviathan 模块化数据中心发往挪威 Fossefall；首批 5 台、合计 9MW 以上，2027 年 Q1 前交付；双方目标 2027 年 Galleon Forge 产能至少 500MW（产能目标，非已签订单）。
timeline.text_en: Armada and JCI launched Galleon Forge Two in Dublin: the 90,000 sq ft plant began continuous production, with the first Leviathan modular data centre shipped to Fossefall, Norway; the first batch is 5 units totalling over 9MW, to be delivered before Q1 2027; the partners target at least 500MW of Galleon Forge capacity in 2027 (a capacity target, not signed orders).

events.title: 大金发布 60MW AI 工厂制冷参考架构 D60-W
events.title_en: Daikin releases 60MW AI-factory cooling reference architecture D60-W

timeline.change: 大金发布 60MW AI 工厂制冷参考架构 D60-W：适配 NVIDIA DSX 平台与 Vera Rubin NVL72 机柜，液冷承担 92% 负荷，核心为无油磁悬浮 Magnitude WME 离心机（单台最大 10MW）；自研 CDU 与数据中心干冷器目标 2027 年下半年供货
timeline.text_en: Daikin released the 60MW AI-factory cooling reference architecture D60-W: built for the NVIDIA DSX platform and Vera Rubin NVL72 racks, with liquid cooling carrying 92% of the load, centered on oil-free magnetic-bearing Magnitude WME chillers (up to 10MW each); in-house CDU and data-center dry coolers targeted for H2 2027

events.title: Modine 得州 Grand Prairie 冷水机新厂投产
events.title_en: Modine starts production at new Grand Prairie, Texas chiller plant

timeline.change: Modine 位于得州 Grand Prairie 的 68.2 万平方英尺 Airedale 冷水机新厂开始商业化生产，专产带免费制冷的 2MW 与 3MW 冷水机，目标本财年末达到 4 条 2MW 产线，将成为其全球最大的 Airedale 冷水机生产基地
timeline.text_en: Modine began commercial production at its 682,000 sq ft Airedale chiller plant in Grand Prairie, Texas, dedicated to 2MW and 3MW chillers with free cooling, targeting four 2MW lines by fiscal year-end; it will become its largest Airedale chiller plant worldwide

events.title: 安森美 6 亿美元现金收购 Ferric（AI 数据中心电源）
events.title_en: onsemi acquires Ferric for $600M cash (AI data-center power)

timeline.change: 安森美宣布以 6 亿美元现金收购 Ferric（另加最高 1.75 亿美元里程碑），AI 数据中心相关营收预计 2026 年同比翻倍以上、2027 年再翻倍；Q3 营收 17.2 亿美元
timeline.text_en: onsemi announced the acquisition of Ferric for $600M in cash (plus up to $175M in milestones); AI data-center-related revenue is expected to more than double in 2026 and double again in 2027; Q3 revenue was $1.72B

events.title: 联想发布"万全混合词元工厂"、张家口首个母本工厂签约
events.title_en: Lenovo launches "Wanquan hybrid token factory", first mother factory signed in Zhangjiakou

timeline.change: 联想发布"万全混合词元工厂"品牌并与张家口市政府签约落地首个母本工厂，初期规划 1.5 万 P 异构算力集群、约 100MW 智算中心，词元年产量超 2000 万亿，配套智算中心 PUE 低于 1.1、采用全栈液冷
timeline.text_en: Lenovo launched the "Wanquan hybrid token factory" brand and signed with the Zhangjiakou municipal government for the first mother factory: an initial 15,000-P heterogeneous compute cluster and about 100MW AI compute center, annual token output above 2,000 trillion, with a PUE below 1.1 and full-stack liquid cooling

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-11 收 3,068.5 美元/吨（+1.9%），现货较三个月期货升水一度达 151.50 美元/吨（30 年来最高），LME 可交割库存降至 1990 年以来最低、很大一部分剩余库存被两家交易商控制；沪铝 12 月合约 11-12 盘中一度涨 2.65%。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M aluminium closed Nov 11 at $3,068.5/t (+1.9%); the cash-to-3M premium touched $151.50/t, a 30-year high; LME deliverable stocks fell to their lowest since 1990, with much of the remaining stock controlled by two traders; the SHFE December aluminium contract rose as much as 2.65% intraday on Nov 12.

timeline.change: 现货升水 11-12 盘中达 176.80 美元/吨（1990 年 11 月以来最高、36 年纪录），刷新 151.50 美元/吨的 30 年纪录；LME 库存降至 226,350 吨（不到 1 月均值 498,670 吨的一半），99.98% 为俄罗斯 origin、单一持有者占 30–39% 仓单；11 月合约 11-18 到期、持仓总量已超交易所全部库存。
timeline.text_en: The cash premium touched $176.80/t intraday on Nov 12, the highest since November 1990 (a 36-year record), topping the $151.50/t 30-year record; LME stocks fell to 226,350 t (under half the January average of 498,670 t), 99.98% of Russian origin, with a single holder controlling 30-39% of warrants; the November contract expires Nov 18 with open interest already above total exchange stocks.

timeline.change: Trafigura 已建立大规模 LME 铝多头、拟运往中国出售，11 月主力合约多头头寸合计超过交易所全部库存；LME 3M 11-13 收约 3,018–3,025 美元/吨；SMM 提示到期后多头移仓、升水回吐的尾部风险；11 月合约 11-18 到期。
timeline.text_en: Trafigura has built a large LME aluminium long position for shipment to China, with November longs in aggregate exceeding total exchange stocks; LME 3M closed Nov 13 at about $3,018-3,025/t; SMM flagged tail risk of premium give-back as longs roll after expiry; the November contract expires Nov 18.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-13 官方结算 3,018 美元/吨，现货 3,150.50 美元/吨；现货升水 11-12 盘中 176.80 美元/吨仍为 36 年最宽，11-13 官方结算价差 132.50 美元/吨；LME 库存 224,150 吨（1990 年以来最低）；11 月合约合计持仓大于全部库存，4 名未披露多头合计持有至少 25% 未平仓量；11 月合约 11-18 到期。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M settled Nov 13 at $3,018/t, cash at $3,150.50/t; the cash premium touched $176.80/t intraday Nov 12, still a 36-year high, with the Nov 13 official cash-to-3M spread at $132.50/t; LME stocks fell to 224,150 t, the lowest since 1990; aggregate November open interest exceeds total exchange stocks, with four undisclosed longs holding at least 25% of open interest; the November contract expires Nov 18.

timeline.change: LME 3M 11-16 约 3,010–3,019 美元/吨；现货对 3M 升水 11-16 扩大至 275 美元/吨，大幅超过 11-12 盘中高点 176.80 美元/吨，路透称紧张程度为 1988、1990 年双重挤仓以来未见；LME 库存 224,150 吨（11-13，1990 年以来最低）；11 月合约合计持仓大于交易所全部库存，4 名未披露多头合计持有至少 25% 未平仓量；11 月合约 11-18 到期，截至 11-16 未见 LME 触发强制借贷规则或紧急干预的新通报。
timeline.text_en: LME 3M aluminium was about $3,010-3,019/t on Nov 16; the cash-to-3M premium widened to $275/t on Nov 16, far above the $176.80/t intraday high of Nov 12, with Reuters calling the tightness unseen since the 1988 and 1990 squeezes; LME stocks stood at 224,150 t (Nov 13, lowest since 1990); aggregate November open interest exceeds total exchange stocks, with four undisclosed longs holding at least 25% of open interest; the November contract expires Nov 18, and as of Nov 16 there was no new notice of LME triggering forced lending or emergency intervention.

timeline.change: 11 月主合约 11-18 到期；现货升水 11-16 为 275 美元/吨（36 年新高），LME 铝 11-17 跌 2.0% 至 2,942.5 美元/吨；SMM 提示到期后多头移仓与现货升水回吐的尾部风险。
timeline.text_en: November main contract expires Nov 18; cash premium was $275/t on Nov 16 (36-year high), LME aluminium fell 2.0% to $2,942.5/t on Nov 17; SMM warns of tail risk from long position rollover and premium give-back after expiry.

timeline.change: 11 月主合约 11-18 到期；现货对 3M 升水 11-17 仍约 278 美元/吨，cash-to-December 价差自约 190 美元/吨收窄；LME 铝库存 11-17 降至 221,900 吨（1990 年以来最低）。
timeline.text_en: The November prompt contract expired Nov 18; the cash-to-3M premium was still about $278/t on Nov 17, with the cash-to-December spread narrowing from about $190/t; LME aluminium stocks fell to 221,900 t on Nov 17, the lowest since 1990.

LME 3M aluminium fell below $3,000 on 11-18, official price $2,864/t (-2.4%, a year low); the cash premium hit about $275/t on 11-17 (highest since the 1988-1990 squeeze) and eased to $230 on 11-18; it closed at $2,814.5 on 11-19 (+0.90%).

LME 3M aluminium closed at $2,870/t on Nov 20 (+1.66%); SHFE aluminium's most-traded contract was RMB 21,330/t (-1.66%); domestic A00 aluminium ingot was RMB 22,340/t with a RMB 390/t premium; electrolytic aluminium inventory of 396,000 t continued to draw down.

timeline.change: LME 铝约 2,847 美元/吨（-0.78%），现货对三个月升水创纪录 323.50 美元/吨；LME 库存 224,425 吨，上期所铝库存 128,673 吨，SMM 三地铝锭库存 299,000 吨（去库 46,500 吨）。
timeline.text_en: LME aluminium about $2,847/t (-0.78%), cash-to-3M premium hit a record $323.50/t; LME stocks 224,425 t, SHFE stocks 128,673 t, SMM three-region ingot stocks 299,000 t (down 46,500 t).

events.title: 铝现货升水创 36 年纪录、LME 库存 1990 年以来最低
events.title_en: Aluminium spot premium hits 36-year record; LME stocks lowest since 1990

timeline.change: 彭博 11-12 爆料三星洽购美国数据中心制冷商 Modine，未做最终决定、谈判可能破裂，三星与 Modine 均拒绝置评；Modine 市值约 56 亿美元；Modine 11-11 得州 Grand Prairie 新厂量产 2–3MW 数据中心冷水机、Q3 数据中心业务收入 4.397 亿美元（+95%）。
timeline.text_en: Bloomberg reported Nov 12 that Samsung is in talks to acquire US data-center cooling maker Modine, with no final decision made and talks possibly collapsing; both companies declined to comment. Modine is valued at about $5.6bn; its new Grand Prairie, Texas plant began volume production of 2-3MW data-center chillers on Nov 11, and its Q3 data-center revenue was $439.7m (+95%).

timeline.change: 截至 11-14 仍无双方确认、签约或新报价，状态仍为洽谈中、未确认；Modine 11-12 盘后涨约 29%、11-13 盘中涨约 28–33% 至约 137 美元；韩媒引分析师估算全购价约 75–80 亿美元（非官方报价）。
timeline.text_en: As of Nov 14 there is still no confirmation, signing or new offer from either side; the talks remain unconfirmed; Modine rose about 29% after hours on Nov 12 and 28-33% intraday on Nov 13 to about $137; Korean media cited analyst estimates of a $7.5-8.0 billion full-buy price (not an official offer).

timeline.change: 截至 11-16 早仍无双方确认、签约或新报价，状态仍为洽谈中、未确认；Modine 定于 11-18 举行分析师与投资者日。
timeline.text_en: As of the morning of Nov 16 there is still no confirmation, signing or new offer from either side; the talks remain unconfirmed; Modine holds its analyst and investor day on Nov 18.

timeline.change: Modine 11-16 宣布股东投票通过、公司正式更名为 Modexus Solutions（股票代码仍为 MOD），11-18 举行分析师与投资者日，将更新多年增长战略与新财务目标；FY2027 指引：持续经营营收 31–32 亿美元、调整后 EBITDA 4.7–5 亿美元，数据中心营收 +80–90%；三星 11-16 披露 Q3 季报：1–9 月累计营收 500.6261 万亿韩元（+108.8%），营业利润 254.1657 万亿韩元（约 +10.8 倍）；洽购谈判截至 11-16 仍无双方确认、无报价；Modine 11-13 收 135.66 美元（+27.86%）、当周累计 +40.42%。
timeline.text_en: Modine announced on Nov 16 that shareholders approved renaming the company Modexus Solutions (ticker still MOD); its analyst and investor day is Nov 18, where it will update its multi-year growth strategy and financial targets; FY2027 guidance: continuing-operations revenue $3.1-3.2bn, adjusted EBITDA $470-500m, data-center revenue +80-90%; Samsung reported Q3 results on Nov 16: January-September revenue KRW 500.6261tn (+108.8%), operating profit KRW 254.1657tn (about 10.8x); the acquisition talks remain unconfirmed with no offer as of Nov 16; Modine closed Nov 13 at $135.66 (+27.86%), up 40.42% for the week.

timeline.change: Modexus 11-18 投资者日发布 FY2029 目标（营收 57–77 亿美元、数据中心 45–65 亿美元）与 5 亿美元回购，均未提及三星；Jana Partners 同日公开要求 Modexus 提升利润率或考虑出售；双方仍未证实收购。
timeline.text_en: At its Nov 18 investor day Modexus set FY2029 targets (revenue $5.7-7.7B, data centre $4.5-6.5B) and a $500M buyback, with no mention of Samsung; Jana Partners publicly urged Modexus the same day to raise margins or consider a sale; neither side has confirmed a deal.

timeline.change: 截至 11-20 仍无新进展；Modexus 投资者日与回购公告均未提及三星。
timeline.text_en: No new developments as of 11-20; neither Modexus' investor day nor its buyback announcement mentioned Samsung.

timeline.change: 截至 11-21 仍无收购新进展；Modexus 11-18 投资者日提 FY2029 目标与 5 亿美元回购、未提及三星；Jana Partners 施压要求提升利润率或考虑出售。
timeline.text_en: No new developments as of Nov 21; Modexus' Nov 18 investor day set FY2029 targets and a $500M buyback without mentioning Samsung; Jana Partners is pressing for higher margins or a sale.

events.title: 三星洽购美国数据中心制冷商 Modine（彭博爆料，在谈未证实）
events.title_en: Samsung in talks to acquire US data-center cooling maker Modine (Bloomberg report, unconfirmed)

timeline.change: Vertiv 发布 PowerStation 3100 RPP：面向 100kW 以上 AI/HPC 机架的远程配电盘，600–1,200A 单一硬件平台，北美即刻供货；容量为传统配电盘式 RPP 的 3–5 倍，可单机架切断电源、配合液冷漏液隔离。
timeline.text_en: Vertiv launched the PowerStation 3100 RPP, a remote power panel for 100kW+ AI/HPC racks on a single 600-1,200A hardware platform, available immediately in North America; capacity is 3-5x a conventional panelboard-style RPP, with per-rack power cut-off for liquid-cooling leak isolation.

events.title: Vertiv 发布 PowerStation 3100 RPP（100kW+ 机架高密度配电）
events.title_en: Vertiv launches PowerStation 3100 RPP for 100kW+ high-density racks

timeline.change: 英飞凌 11-09 宣布在奥地利 Villach 工厂成功加工出功能性 300mm SiC 功率器件（用现有 300mm 硅产线），单片晶圆芯片数约为 200mm 的 2.3 倍；量产时间表待与客户商定，200mm SiC 路线图不变。
timeline.text_en: Infineon announced Nov 9 that it has processed functional 300mm SiC power devices at its Villach, Austria fab (using an existing 300mm silicon line), with about 2.3x the chips per wafer of 200mm; the volume-production timetable is to be agreed with customers, and the 200mm SiC roadmap is unchanged.

timeline.change: 2026 财年营收 163.53 亿欧元（同比 +12%），Q4 营收 47.06 亿欧元创纪录，SiC 收入 7 亿欧元（+10%）、2027 财年预计超 10 亿欧元，2027 财年营收指引约 200 亿欧元。
timeline.text_en: Fiscal 2026 revenue EUR 16.353 billion (+12% year on year), Q4 revenue a record EUR 4.706 billion, SiC revenue EUR 700 million (+10%) and expected above EUR 1 billion in fiscal 2027, with fiscal 2027 revenue guidance of about EUR 20 billion.

events.title: 英飞凌加工出功能性 300mm SiC 功率器件
events.title_en: Infineon processes functional 300mm SiC power devices

timeline.change: 黄仁勋即刻辞去总裁、CEO 与董事职务，结束 33 年任期，董事会未给理由；CFO Colette Kress 兼任临时 CEO（保留 CFO 职务），Harvey C. Jones 任首任董事长，永久 CEO 内外候选人遴选中、无时间表；当日股价开盘跌约 13%、收盘跌 4.34% 至 166.19 美元。
timeline.text_en: Jensen Huang resigned immediately as president, CEO and director, ending a 33-year tenure, with no reason given by the board; CFO Colette Kress serves as interim CEO while keeping the CFO role, Harvey C. Jones becomes the first board chair, and the search for a permanent CEO is under way with no timetable; shares opened down about 13% and closed down 4.34% at $166.19.

timeline.change: 股价再跌 2.01% 至 162.85 美元；Morningstar 将公允价值下调 19% 至 310 美元；11-17 盘后发布 FY2027 Q3 财报。
timeline.text_en: Shares fell another 2.01% to $162.85; Morningstar cut its fair value by 19% to $310; FY2027 Q3 results are due after the close on Nov 17.

timeline.change: 11-17 盘后发布 FY2027 Q3 财报（公司指引营收 1,080 亿美元 ±2%，市场预期约 1,092 亿美元、调整后 EPS 约 2.48 美元）；临时 CEO Kress 首次主持电话会，Q4 指引与毛利率（或探至 71%–72%）为关键。
timeline.text_en: FY2027 Q3 results are due after the close on Nov 17 (company guidance $108.0bn +/-2%; consensus about $109.2bn and adjusted EPS about $2.48); interim CEO Kress hosts the call for the first time, with Q4 guidance and gross margin (possibly down to 71%-72%) the key watch items.

timeline.change: NVDA 11-16 收 156.14 美元（-4.12%），较 52 周高点 243.37 美元（10-06）回落约 35.9%；美国商务部 BIS 11-16 发布临时最终规则：向印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、巴西出口先进半导体须申请许可证，并堵住中国企业经第三国数据中心远程租用算力的漏洞（远程算力条款 90 天后生效）；董事会未讨论让黄仁勋回归（CNBC 11-16），财长贝森特称董事会应从外部物色新 CEO；英伟达定于 11-17 盘后发布 FY2027 Q3 财报，市场一致预期营收约 1,092 亿美元、调整后 EPS 约 2.47–2.48 美元，数据中心收入预期约 1,018 亿美元。
timeline.text_en: NVDA closed Nov 16 at $156.14 (-4.12%), about 35.9% below its 52-week high of $243.37 (Oct 6); the US Commerce Department (BIS) issued an interim final rule on Nov 16 requiring licences for advanced-semiconductor exports to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil, and closing the loophole of Chinese firms remotely renting compute via third-country data centers (remote-compute provisions take effect in 90 days); the board has not discussed bringing Jensen Huang back (CNBC, Nov 16), and Treasury Secretary Bessent said the board should look for an outside CEO; Nvidia reports FY2027 Q3 results after the close on Nov 17, with consensus revenue of about $109.2bn and adjusted EPS of about $2.47-2.48, and data-center revenue expected at about $101.8bn.

timeline.change: 11-19 股价收 145.98 美元（-3.30%），连续第六个交易日下跌，5 日跌幅约 16%；董事会 11-17 明确拒黄仁勋复任 CEO。
timeline.text_en: Shares closed at $145.98 on 11-19 (-3.30%), a sixth straight daily decline and about -16% over five sessions; the board stated on 11-17 that it will not reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

timeline.change: 11-20 收盘 125.53 美元（-14.01%，盘中最低 124.50 美元），连续第七个交易日下跌，5 日跌幅约 24.5%、11 月累计约 -43%；盘后反弹至 130.27 美元（+3.78%）；分析师 11-18/19 集中下调目标价，Oppenheimer 下调至 Perform 并取消目标价；SEC 民事调查仍未获证实。
timeline.text_en: Shares closed at $125.53 on Nov 20 (-14.01%, intraday low $124.50), a seventh straight daily decline, about -24.5% over five sessions and about -43% in November; they rebounded to $130.27 after hours (+3.78%); analysts cut price targets on Nov 18-19, Oppenheimer downgrading to Perform and dropping its target; the reported SEC civil probe remains unconfirmed.

timeline.change: 路透 11-20 独家：SEC 执法人员正在审查英伟达潜在会计问题（SEC 未置评、英伟达未回应）；加州总检察长 11-21 调查芯片转移与误导投资者；特朗普称希望黄仁勋回归；黄仁勋已同意参议院公开作证、12-01 接受众议院三个委员会闭门面谈；股价 11-20 收 125.53 美元（-14.01%），七连跌。
timeline.text_en: Reuters exclusive Nov 20: SEC enforcement staff are reviewing potential accounting issues at Nvidia (SEC declined to comment, Nvidia did not respond); California AG opened an investigation into chip transfers and misleading investors on Nov 21; Trump said he wants Huang back; Huang agreed to testify publicly before the Senate and in closed House sessions on Dec 1; shares closed at $125.53 (-14.01%) on Nov 20, a seventh straight daily loss.

timeline.change: 董事会立场不变：主席 Harvey Jones 称无意让黄仁勋回归 CEO，已聘猎头遴选永久 CEO；特朗普 11-20 称希望黄仁勋回归；NVDA 盘后 11-20 报 130.01 美元（+3.57%）。
timeline.text_en: Board position unchanged: chairman Harvey Jones said there is no intention to bring Huang back as CEO; a headhunter has been engaged for a permanent CEO; Trump said on Nov 20 he wants Huang back; NVDA closed after hours on Nov 20 at $130.01 (+3.57%).

timeline.change: 董事会一致投票恢复黄仁勋 CEO/总裁/董事职务，立即生效，特朗普公开表态支持；NVDA 收 165.05 美元（+31.48%），单日市值增加约 9520 亿美元，纳指 +6.5%；独立董事调查继续，12-01 众议院闭门面谈、12-03 参议院公开作证如期推进，10-Q 法定截止约 12-04。
timeline.text_en: Board unanimously voted to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, president and director, effective immediately, with public support from Trump; NVDA closed at $165.05 (+31.48%), adding about $952B in market value in one day, Nasdaq +6.5%; independent-director investigation continues, House closed-door interviews Dec 1 and Senate public testimony Dec 3 proceed as scheduled, 10-Q statutory deadline about Dec 4.

events.title: 黄仁勋辞任英伟达 CEO、Kress 任临时 CEO
events.title_en: Jensen Huang resigns as Nvidia CEO; Kress named interim CEO

timeline.change: 安森美与捷克工贸部联合宣布取消罗兹诺夫 SiC 扩产计划（2024 年 6 月宣布、上限 20 亿美元），理由为全球 SiC 市场变化；现有硅与 SiC 生产继续。
timeline.text_en: Onsemi and the Czech Ministry of Industry and Trade jointly announced the cancellation of the Roznov SiC expansion (announced June 2024, up to $2 billion), citing changes in the global SiC market; existing silicon and SiC production continues.

timeline.change: 3.0 MVA 户外系统，瞄准 AI 数据中心并网加速与室内空间释放，2027 年中开始发货，已与 QTS、SoftBank、Rosendin 做概念验证；博洛尼亚中压实验室计划 2027 年投运。
timeline.text_en: A 3.0 MVA outdoor system aimed at faster AI data-center grid connection and freeing indoor space for compute, shipping from mid-2027, with proof-of-concept work under way with QTS, SoftBank and Rosendin; a medium-voltage lab in Bologna is planned to open in 2027.

timeline.text_en: On the Oct 29 earnings call, Carrier said residential equipment prices would rise about 8% at the end of Q4, about 10% across the Americas, with full-year input cost pressure of about $800 million, roughly half from tariffs.

timeline.change: Baird 会议明确住宅设备涨价 8% 生效日为 12-15；数据中心销售额 2026 年约 20 亿美元、2027 年约 30 亿美元（订单同比 +350%）。
timeline.text_en: Baird conference clarified the residential equipment +8% hike takes effect Dec 15; data-center sales seen at about $2B in 2026 and about $3B in 2027 (orders +350% YoY).

events.title: 开利住宅设备拟于 Q4 末提价约 8%
events.title_en: Carrier plans ~8% residential equipment price hike at end of Q4

timeline.change: 牙山 Onyang 园区新增 3.1 万平方米洁净室，主攻下一代 HBM 堆叠封装，目标 2028 年 6 月洁净室投运、2029 年 5 月量产，系 46 万亿韩元分阶段封装计划的核心。
timeline.text_en: A new 31,000 sq m cleanroom at the Onyang campus in Asan will focus on next-generation HBM stacked packaging, targeting cleanroom operation in June 2028 and mass production in May 2029, as the core of a KRW 46 trillion phased packaging plan.

events.title: 三星 6 万亿韩元先进封装 Line 5 动工（HBM 封装）
events.title_en: Samsung breaks ground on KRW 6 trillion advanced packaging Line 5 fab (HBM)

timeline.change: Q3 核心收入 2.309 亿美元（同比 +70%），全年指引上调至 9.4–9.6 亿美元，新增微软为第三家超大规模客户；对 OpenAI 首批 250MW 交付已落后，原因是土地、电力与数据中心建设慢于预期，交付延迟延续至 2027 年部分时段、2027 下半年才能赶上；已签约数据中心容量 700MW。
timeline.text_en: Q3 core revenue $230.9 million (+70% year on year), full-year guidance raised to $940-960 million, with Microsoft added as a third hyperscale customer; delivery of the first 250 MW tranche to OpenAI is behind schedule because land, power and data-center construction are slower than expected, with delays extending into parts of 2027 and catch-up only in H2 2027; contracted data-center capacity stands at 700 MW.

timeline.change: Q3 核心营收 2.31 亿美元（同比 +70%），全年指引上调至 9.4–9.6 亿美元；OpenAI 750MW 照单付款合同首批交付延迟（土地、电力与楼宇建设，非芯片），预计 2027 年下半年恢复交付节奏；微软成为第三家超大规模客户。
timeline.text_en: Q3 core revenue was $231m (+70% year on year) and full-year guidance was raised to $9.4-9.6bn; first deliveries under the 750MW take-or-pay OpenAI contract are delayed by land, power and building construction (not chips), with delivery pace expected to recover in H2 2027; Microsoft became the third hyperscale customer.

timeline.change: 大型电力变压器全球采购交期已从 2021 年约 2 年拉长至 160–210 周（3–4 年），主因取向硅钢短缺、绕线技工与高压测试能力不足，Wood Mackenzie 预计 2026 年电力变压器市场短缺 15%；Applied Digital 要求 Oracle、Meta 等大租户及英伟达、AMD 按项目提供数十亿美元财务担保以覆盖新 AI 数据中心并网的电网升级与接网成本；西门子能源 FY2026 backlog 1,640 亿欧元（数据中心客户约占 150 亿欧元），GE Vernova backlog 1,970 亿美元，伊顿数据中心订单滚动 12 个月翻倍以上。
timeline.text_en: Global procurement lead times for large power transformers have stretched from about 2 years in 2021 to 160-210 weeks (3-4 years), driven by grain-oriented electrical steel shortages, winding-labour and high-voltage testing constraints; Wood Mackenzie expects a 15% power-transformer market shortage in 2026; Applied Digital is asking large tenants such as Oracle and Meta, plus Nvidia and AMD, for multi-billion-dollar financial guarantees per project to cover grid upgrade and interconnection costs for new AI data centers; Siemens Energy's FY2026 backlog is EUR 164bn (data-center customers about EUR 15bn), GE Vernova's backlog is $197bn, and Eaton's data-center orders more than doubled on a rolling 12-month basis.

timeline.text_en: Switchgear lead times in some markets have stretched to 2-4 years, with copper cable prices up 22%-36% YoY; a Johns Hopkins study flags a transformer gap of about 15% over the next four years.

timeline.change: 商务部 72 号公告暂停期至 2026-11-27，截至 11-16 未见续延公告；若到期前无新公告，对美镓/锗/锑"原则上不予许可"将于 11-28 起恢复；参照稀土先例，续延仍可能在 11-26–27 日前后出现；受影响品类：GaN 功率器件（变频驱动）、射频器件、锑系阻燃剂（塑料件）、红外光学用锗；中国占全球原生镓供应约 98.9%、锗约 68.6%。
timeline.text_en: The pause under MOFCOM Notice No. 72 runs to November 27, 2026, with no renewal announced as of Nov 16; if no new notice appears before expiry, the "in principle no licence" stance for gallium, germanium and antimony exports to the US resumes from Nov 28; following the rare-earth precedent, a renewal could still appear around Nov 26-27; affected categories: GaN power devices (VSD drives), RF devices, antimony flame retardants (plastics) and germanium for infrared optics; China accounts for about 98.9% of global primary gallium supply and 68.6% of germanium.

timeline.change: 截至 11-19 约 08:00 仍无续延公告，暂停期按 2026-11-27 到期，倒计时 8 天；若到期前无新公告，对美镓/锗/锑"原则上不予许可"将于 11-28 起恢复。
timeline.text_en: As of about 08:00 on Nov 19 there was still no extension notice; the pause expires Nov 27, with 8 days left; without a new notice, the "in principle no licences" stance for gallium, germanium and antimony exports to the US resumes Nov 28.

timeline.change: 截至 11-20 约 07:35 仍无续延公告，暂停按 11-27 到期，倒计时 7 天；锗锭 11 月第一周报价创历史新高 29,000 元/公斤。
timeline.text_en: As of about 07:35 on 11-20, no extension announcement has appeared; the suspension still expires 11-27, with 7 days to go; germanium ingot prices hit a record high of RMB 29,000/kg in the first week of November.

timeline.change: 截至 11-21 早上仍无续延公告，倒计时 6 天；商务部 9-28 吉隆坡安排延至 2027-01-10 的表态未点名 72 号公告。
timeline.text_en: As of the morning of Nov 21, no extension notice had been published; six days remain. The ministry's Sep 28 statement extending the Kuala Lumpur arrangement to Jan 10, 2027 did not mention Announcement No. 72.

timeline.change: 截至 11-22 早上仍无续延公告，倒计时 5 天。
timeline.text_en: As of the morning of Nov 22, still no extension notice; 5 days to expiry.

timeline.change: 截至 11-23 早上仍无续延公告，倒计时 4 天。
timeline.text_en: As of the morning of Nov 23, still no extension notice; 4 days to expiry.

timeline.change: BIS 发布临时最终规则，新增 §744.24 数据中心最终用途管制：向总部位于中国、澳门或 D:5 国家集团的企业提供超 1200 万 TPP 算力接入须申请许可证，现有数据中心 90 天过渡期；向印尼、马来西亚、新加坡、泰国、巴西出口先进 AI 物项新增许可证要求；正式废止《AI 扩散规则》。
timeline.text_en: BIS issued an interim final rule adding Section 744.24 data-centre end-use controls: a licence is required where a data centre provides over 12 million TPP of compute access to entities headquartered in China, Macau or D:5 destinations, with a 90-day transition for existing centres; new licence requirements for advanced AI items to Indonesia, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Brazil; the AI Diffusion Framework is formally rescinded.

timeline.change: 规则今日 11-19 刊登《联邦公报》并生效：§744.24 远程算力接入管制落地（1200 万 TPP 阈值、90 天过渡期）；新加坡称"正在仔细研究细节"、马来西亚称运营商必须合规并正起草披露法律、中国外交部称"典型的经济胁迫和长臂管辖"。
timeline.text_en: The rule took effect today, Nov 19, upon publication in the Federal Register: Section 744.24 remote-compute-access controls apply (12 million TPP threshold, 90-day transition); Singapore said it is "studying the details carefully", Malaysia said operators must comply and is drafting disclosure rules, and China's Foreign Ministry called it "typical economic coercion and long-arm jurisdiction".

timeline.change: 中国商务部同日表态强烈不满、称若美方一意孤行将采取反制（反制未定案）。
timeline.text_en: China's commerce ministry said the same day it strongly opposes the rule and will take countermeasures if the US persists (no countermeasure decided).

timeline.text_en: FT Nov 19: TSMC and Samsung suspended some chip shipments to China from Nov 19 to apply for licences.
